title.zh: 卷四 齊本紀上第四 高帝 武帝
title.en: Volume 4 Southern Qi Annals 1: Emperor Gao, Emperor Wu
title.raw: 卷四 齊本紀上第四 高帝 武帝 Volume 4 Southern Qi Annals 1: Emperor Gao, Emperor Wu

sentences.zh: 齊本紀上第四

translations.literal: Qi Annals, upper scroll, fourth.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Qi Annals, Part One.

sentences.zh: 皇曾祖雋，字子武，位即丘令。

translations.literal: The emperor's great-grandfather Juan, style name Ziwu, served as Magistrate of Jiqiu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's great-grandfather Juan, whose style name was Ziwu, held the post of Magistrate of Jiqiu.

sentences.zh: 皇祖樂子，字閨子，位輔國參軍，宋升明中贈太常。

translations.literal: The emperor's grandfather Yuezi, style name Guizi, served as Aide to the General Who Supports the State; in the Shengming era of Song he was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Minister of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's grandfather Yuezi, whose style name was Guizi, served as Aide to the General Who Supports the State; during the Shengming era of Song he was posthumously granted the title Grand Minister of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 皇考承之，字嗣伯，少有大志，才力過人，仕宋為漢中太守。

translations.literal: The emperor's father Chengzhi, style name Sibo, from youth had great ambition; his talent and strength surpassed others; he served Song as Governor of Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's father Chengzhi, whose style name was Sibo, had harbored great ambition from youth; his talent and strength surpassed those of ordinary men, and he served Song as Governor of Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 梁州之平，以功加龍驤將軍，後為南泰山太守，封晉興縣五等男，遷右軍將軍。

translations.literal: When Liang Province was pacified, for his merit he was promoted to General of Dragon Cavalry; later he became Governor of South Mount Tai and was enfeoffed as Fifth-Rank Baron of Jinxing County; he was transferred to General of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: When Liang Province was pacified, he was promoted to General of Dragon Cavalry for his merit; later he served as Governor of South Mount Tai, was enfeoffed as Fifth-Rank Baron of Jinxing County, and was transferred to General of the Right.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十四年殂，梁土思之，於峨公山立廟祭祀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia he died; the people of Liang missed him, and on Mount E'gong a temple was erected for his worship.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia; the people of Liang mourned him, and a temple was erected on Mount E'gong for his worship.

sentences.zh: 升明二年，贈散騎常侍、金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shengming he was posthumously granted Attendant Cavalier at Regular Attendance and Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shengming he was posthumously granted the titles Attendant Cavalier at Regular Attendance and Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 高帝以宋元嘉四年丁卯歲生，姿表英異，龍顙鐘聲，長七尺五寸，鱗文遍體。

translations.literal: Emperor Gao was born in the fourth year of Yuanjia of Song, in the year dingmao; his bearing was outstanding and unusual, his dragon forehead and bell-like voice remarkable; he stood seven feet five inches; scale-like markings covered his entire body.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gao was born in the fourth year of Yuanjia of Song, in the year dingmao; his bearing was striking and unusual, with a dragon-like forehead and a bell-like voice; he stood seven feet five inches tall, and scale-like markings covered his entire body.

sentences.zh: 舊宅在武進縣，宅南有一桑樹，擢本三丈，橫生四枝，狀似華蓋。

translations.literal: The old residence was in Wujin County; south of the residence was a mulberry tree whose trunk rose three zhang and spread four branches horizontally, shaped like a ceremonial canopy.
translations.idiomatic: The family residence lay in Wujin County; south of the house stood a mulberry tree whose trunk rose three zhang and spread four horizontal branches, shaped like a ceremonial canopy.

sentences.zh: 帝年數歲，好戲其下，從兄敬宗曰：「此樹為汝生也。

translations.literal: When the emperor was several years old he loved to play beneath it; his elder cousin Jingzong said: "This tree was born for you.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was still a small child he loved to play beneath it; his elder cousin Jingzong said, "This tree was born for you.

sentences.zh: 」儒生雷次宗立學於雞籠山，帝年十三，就受禮及左氏春秋。

translations.literal: " The Confucian scholar Lei Cizong established a school on Mount Jilong; at thirteen the emperor went there to study the Rites and the Zuo Commentary to the Spring and Autumn Annals.
translations.idiomatic: " The Confucian scholar Lei Cizong established a school on Mount Jilong; at thirteen the emperor went there to study the Rites and the Zuo Commentary to the Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 十七年，宋大將軍彭城王義康被黜，徙豫章，皇考領兵防守，帝舍業南行。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, the Song Grand General Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was deposed and exiled to Yuzhang; the emperor's father led troops to guard him, and the emperor abandoned his studies and traveled south.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, the Song Grand General Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was deposed and exiled to Yuzhang; the emperor's father led troops to guard him, and the emperor set aside his studies and traveled south.

sentences.zh: 十九年，竟陵蠻動，宋文帝遣帝領偏軍討沔北蠻。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, when the barbarians of Jingling stirred, Emperor Wen of Song dispatched the emperor to lead a detached force to suppress the northern-bank barbarians of the Mian River.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, when the barbarians of Jingling rose in revolt, Emperor Wen of Song sent the emperor to lead a detached force against the northern-bank barbarians of the Mian River.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，雍州刺史蕭思話鎮襄陽，啟帝自隨，初為左軍中兵參軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, when Governor of Yong Province Xiao Sihua garrisoned Xiangyang, he requested that the emperor accompany him; at first he served as Army Controller of the Left Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, when Xiao Sihua, Governor of Yong Province, garrisoned Xiangyang, he requested that the emperor accompany him; at first the emperor served as Army Controller of the Left Army.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，領偏軍征仇池，破其武興、蘭皋二壘，遂從谷口入關。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he led a detached force to campaign against Chouchi, broke its two fortresses of Wuxing and Lan'gao, and then entered the pass from Gukou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he led a detached force against Chouchi, captured its fortresses of Wuxing and Lan'gao, and then entered the pass from Gukou.

sentences.zh: 未至長安八十里，梁州刺史劉秀之遣司馬馬注助帝，攻拔談提城。

translations.literal: When still eighty li from Chang'an, Governor of Liang Province Liu Xiuzhi sent the Major Ma Zhu to assist the emperor in capturing Tanti city.
translations.idiomatic: When still eighty li from Chang'an, Liu Xiuzhi, Governor of Liang Province, sent his Major Ma Zhu to assist the emperor in capturing Tanti city.

sentences.zh: 魏救兵至，帝軍力疲少，又聞文帝崩，乃燒城還南鄭。

translations.literal: When Wei relief troops arrived, the emperor's army was exhausted and few; moreover he heard that Emperor Wen had died, so he burned the city and returned to Nanzheng.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei relief troops arrived, the emperor's forces were exhausted and few; learning moreover that Emperor Wen had died, he burned the city and withdrew to Nanzheng.

sentences.zh: 後襲爵晉興縣五等男。

translations.literal: Later he inherited the title Fifth-Rank Baron of Jinxing County.
translations.idiomatic: Later he inherited the title of Fifth-Rank Baron of Jinxing County.

sentences.zh: 為建康令，有能名。

translations.literal: He served as Magistrate of Jiankang and gained a reputation for competence.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Magistrate of Jiankang and gained a reputation for competence.

sentences.zh: 少府蕭惠開雅有知人鑒，謂人曰：「昔魏武為洛陽北部時，人服其英，今看蕭建康，但當過之耳。」

translations.literal: Director of Palace Supplies Xiao Huikai was skilled at judging men and said to others: "In old times when Wei Wu served as northern commander of Luoyang, people admired his brilliance; now look at Xiao of Jiankang — he should surpass even that."
translations.idiomatic: Director of Palace Supplies Xiao Huikai was skilled at judging men and said to others, "When Wei Wu served as northern commander of Luoyang, people admired his brilliance; now look at Xiao of Jiankang — he should surpass even that."

sentences.zh: 江州刺史晉安王子勳遣臨川內史張淹自鄱陽嶠道入三吳，明帝遣帝討之。

translations.literal: Prince of Jin'an Zi Xu, Governor of Jiang Province, sent Interior Secretary of Linchuan Zhang Yan by the Poyang ridge route into the Three Wu region; Emperor Ming dispatched the emperor to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jin'an Zi Xu, Governor of Jiang Province, sent Interior Secretary of Linchuan Zhang Yan by the Poyang ridge route into the Three Wu region; Emperor Ming dispatched the emperor to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 時朝廷器甲皆充南討，帝軍容寡闕，乃編棕皮為馬具裝，折竹為寄生，夜舉火進軍。

translations.literal: At that time the court's armor and weapons were all committed to the southern campaign; the emperor's military equipment was sparse and lacking, so he wove palm bark into horse trappings, broke bamboo into parasols, and advanced by night with torches.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the court's armor and weapons were all committed to the southern campaign; the emperor's equipment was sparse, so he wove palm bark into horse trappings, fashioned bamboo into parasols, and advanced by night under torchlight.

sentences.zh: 賊望見恐懼，未戰而走。

translations.literal: The rebels saw this and were terrified; without fighting they fled.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels saw this and fled in terror without giving battle.

sentences.zh: 還，除桂陽王征北司馬、南東海太守，行南徐州事，及張永等敗于彭城，淮南孤弱，以帝為假冠軍將軍、持節、都督北討前鋒諸軍事，鎮淮陰。

translations.literal: On his return he was appointed Northern Campaigning Major of Prince of Guiyang and Governor of East Sea in the south, acting for South Xu Province; when Zhang Yong and others were defeated at Pengcheng and Huainan was isolated and weak, the emperor was made Acting Champion General, Bearer of the Staff, Commander of the Vanguard Forces of the Northern Campaign, and garrisoned Huaiyin.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was appointed Northern Campaigning Major of Prince of Guiyang and Governor of East Sea in the south, acting for South Xu Province; when Zhang Yong and others were defeated at Pengcheng and Huainan stood isolated and weak, the emperor was made Acting Champion General, Bearer of the Staff, Commander of the Vanguard Forces of the Northern Campaign, and garrisoned Huaiyin.

sentences.zh: 遷南兗州刺史，加督五州，督北討如故。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Inspector of South Yan Province, with added supervision over five provinces; his command of the northern campaign remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Inspector of South Yan Province with added supervision over five provinces, while his command of the northern campaign remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 明帝嫌帝非人臣相，而人間流言，帝當為天子，明帝愈以為疑，遣冠軍將軍吳喜留軍破釜，自持銀壺酒封以賜帝。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming suspected that the emperor did not have the countenance of a subject, and among the people there were rumors that the emperor would become Son of Heaven; Emperor Ming grew ever more suspicious, sent Champion General Wu Xi to leave troops at Pofu, and personally held a silver flask of wine sealed and bestowed it on the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming suspected that the emperor lacked the bearing of a subject, and among the people rumors spread that he would become Son of Heaven; the emperor grew ever more suspicious, sent Champion General Wu Xi to leave troops at Pofu, and personally held a silver flask of sealed wine to bestow upon the emperor.

sentences.zh: 帝戎服出門迎，懼鴆，不敢飲，將出奔，喜告以誠，先飲之，帝即酌飲之。

translations.literal: The emperor in military dress went out to receive him, fearing poison and not daring to drink; about to flee, Xi told him in earnest and first drank himself; the emperor then poured and drank.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in military dress went out to receive him, fearing poison and not daring to drink; about to flee, Xi spoke to him in earnest and first drank himself, whereupon the emperor poured and drank.

sentences.zh: 喜還，明帝意乃悅。

translations.literal: When Xi returned, Emperor Ming's mind was then pleased.
translations.idiomatic: When Xi returned, Emperor Ming's mind was at ease.

sentences.zh: 泰始七年，征還都，部下勸勿就征。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Taishi he was summoned back to the capital; his subordinates urged him not to obey the summons.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Taishi he was summoned back to the capital; his subordinates urged him not to obey the summons.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「主上自誅諸弟，為太子幼弱，作萬歲後計，何關他族。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The sovereign himself has killed his brothers; for the sake of the crown prince's youth he is making plans for after his ten-thousand-year reign — what has that to do with other clans?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The sovereign himself has killed his brothers; for the sake of the crown prince's youth he is making plans for the long reign ahead — what has that to do with other clans?

sentences.zh: 惟應速發，事緩當見疑。

translations.literal: One should only set out quickly; if the matter is delayed one will be suspected.
translations.idiomatic: We should set out at once; if the matter is delayed we shall be suspected.

sentences.zh: 今骨肉相害，自非靈長之運，禍難將興，方與卿等戮力耳。

translations.literal: Now with kin slaying kin, this is not the fortune of a sage ruler; calamity and hardship are about to arise — let us strive together with you.
translations.idiomatic: Now that kin are slaying kin, this is not the fortune of a sage ruler; calamity is about to arise — let us strive together.

sentences.zh: 」至，拜散騎常侍、太子左衛率。

translations.literal: " On arrival he was appointed Attendant Cavalier at Regular Attendance and Left Commandant of the Crown Prince's Guard.
translations.idiomatic: " On arrival he was appointed Attendant Cavalier at Regular Attendance and Left Commandant of the Crown Prince's Guard.

sentences.zh: 明帝崩，遺詔為右衛將軍，領衛尉，加兵五百人，與尚書令袁粲、護軍褚彥回、領軍劉勉共掌機事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming died, by his final testament the emperor was made General of the Right Guard, Director of the Court of Palace Receptions, with an additional five hundred troops; together with Director of the Department of State Affairs Yuan Can, Protector of the Army Chu Yanhui, and Commander of the Palace Guard Liu Mian he jointly managed affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming died, by his final testament the emperor was made General of the Right Guard and Director of the Court of Palace Receptions, with an additional five hundred troops; together with Yuan Can, Director of the Department of State Affairs, Chu Yanhui, Protector of the Army, and Liu Mian, Commander of the Palace Guard, he jointly managed affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 尋解衛尉，加侍中，領石頭戍軍事。

translations.literal: Soon he was relieved of the Court of Palace Receptions, promoted to Palace Attendant, and put in charge of the garrison at Shitou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was relieved of the Court of Palace Receptions, promoted to Palace Attendant, and put in charge of the garrison at Shitou.

sentences.zh: 元徽二年五月，江州刺史桂陽王休范舉兵于尋陽，朝廷惶駭，帝與褚彥回等集中書省計議，莫有言者。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Yuanhui, Prince of Guiyang Xiufan raised troops at Xunyang; the court was terrified; the emperor with Chu Yanhui and others gathered at the Secretariat to deliberate, and no one spoke.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Yuanhui, Prince of Guiyang Xiufan raised troops at Xunyang; the court was terrified; the emperor with Chu Yanhui and others gathered at the Secretariat to deliberate, and no one spoke.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「昔上流謀逆，皆因淹緩以敗，休範必遠懲前失，輕兵急下，乘我無備，請頓新亭以當其鋒。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "In the past when the upper reaches plotted rebellion, all failed through delay; Xiufan will surely take distant warning from past failures, advance lightly and quickly, and strike while we are unprepared — I ask that we halt at Xinting to meet his edge.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "In the past rebellions in the upper reaches all failed through delay; Xiufan will surely take warning from past failures, advance lightly and quickly, and strike while we are unprepared — I ask that we halt at Xinting to meet his edge.

sentences.zh: 」因索筆下議，餘並注同。

translations.literal: " He then asked for a brush and wrote the proposal; the rest all noted agreement.
translations.idiomatic: " He then asked for a brush and wrote the proposal; the rest all noted their agreement.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人孫千齡與休範有密契，獨曰：「宜依舊遣軍據梁山。

translations.literal: Palace Secretariat Attendant Sun Qianling had a secret pact with Xiufan and alone said: "It is fitting as before to dispatch troops to hold Liangshan.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Secretariat Attendant Sun Qianling had a secret pact with Xiufan and alone said, "It is fitting as before to dispatch troops to hold Liangshan.

sentences.zh: 」帝正色曰：「賊今已近，梁山豈可得至！

translations.literal: " The emperor with stern countenance said: "The rebels are now near — how can Liangshan be reached!
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor with stern countenance said, "The rebels are now near — how can Liangshan be reached!

sentences.zh: 新亭既是兵沖，所欲以死報國耳。

translations.literal: Xinting is precisely the military crossroads; this is what I desire in dying for the state.
translations.idiomatic: Xinting is precisely the military crossroads; this is where I mean to die for the state.

sentences.zh: 」乃單車白服出新亭。

translations.literal: " He then went out to Xinting alone in a single cart dressed in white.
translations.idiomatic: " He then went out to Xinting alone in a single cart dressed in white.

sentences.zh: 加帝使持節、都督征討諸軍事、平南將軍，加鼓吹一部。

translations.literal: The emperor was promoted to Bearer of the Staff with full credentials, Commander of the Armies for the Punitive Campaign, General Who Pacifies the South, with an additional suite of drums and flutes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was promoted to Bearer of the Staff with full credentials, Commander of the Armies for the Punitive Campaign, and General Who Pacifies the South, with an additional suite of drums and flutes.

sentences.zh: 築新亭城壘未畢，賊前軍已至，帝方解衣高臥，以安眾心。

translations.literal: The ramparts of Xinting city were not yet finished when the rebel vanguard had already arrived; the emperor was just then removing his robe and lying high to calm the people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: The ramparts of Xinting city were not yet finished when the rebel vanguard had already arrived; the emperor was just then removing his robe and lying at ease to calm the people's hearts.

sentences.zh: 乃索白虎幡，登西垣，使甯朔將軍高道慶、羽林監陳顯達、員外郎王敬則，浮舸與賊水戰，大破之。

translations.literal: He then asked for the White Tiger Banner, ascended the western wall, and had General Who Pacifies the North Gao Daoqing, Supervisor of the Forest Guard Chen Xianda, and Outer Department Gentleman Wang Jingze float boats to fight the rebels on the water and greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: He then asked for the White Tiger Banner, ascended the western wall, and had Gao Daoqing, General Who Pacifies the North, Chen Xianda, Supervisor of the Forest Guard, and Wang Jingze, Outer Department Gentleman, float boats to fight the rebels on the water and inflict a great defeat.

sentences.zh: 未時，張敬兒斬休范首，台軍及賊眾俱不知。

translations.literal: At the wei hour Zhang Jing'er cut off Xiufan's head; neither the court army nor the rebel masses knew.
translations.idiomatic: At the wei hour Zhang Jing'er cut off Xiufan's head; neither the court army nor the rebel masses knew.

sentences.zh: 其別率杜黑蠡急攻東壘，帝挺身上馬，帥數百人出戰，與黑蠡拒戰，自晡達明旦，矢石不息。

translations.literal: His separate commander Du Heilí urgently attacked the eastern rampart; the emperor straightened up, mounted a horse, and led several hundred men out to fight; he battled Heilí from the shen hour until dawn the next day without cease of arrows and stones.
translations.idiomatic: His separate commander Du Heilí urgently attacked the eastern rampart; the emperor straightened up, mounted a horse, and led several hundred men out to fight; he battled Heilí from the shen hour until dawn the next day without cease of arrows and stones.

sentences.zh: 其夜大雨，鼓叫不復相聞。

translations.literal: That night a great rain fell; drums and shouts could no longer be heard.
translations.idiomatic: That night a great rain fell; drums and shouts could no longer be heard.

sentences.zh: 將士積日不得寢食，軍中馬夜驚，城內亂走。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers for days could not sleep or eat; horses in the army startled at night and the city fell into disorderly flight.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers for days could neither sleep nor eat; horses in the army startled at night and the city fell into disorderly flight.

sentences.zh: 帝執燭正坐，厲聲呵止之，如是者數四。

translations.literal: The emperor held a candle and sat upright, shouting sternly to stop them — thus four times.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held a candle and sat upright, shouting sternly to stop them — thus four times.

sentences.zh: 賊帥丁文豪設伏，破台軍於皁莢橋，直至朱雀航，王道隆、劉勉並戰沒。

translations.literal: The rebel commander Ding Wenhao set an ambush and broke the court army at Zaojia Bridge, advancing straight to the Zhuque Floating Bridge; Wang Daolong and Liu Mian both fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel commander Ding Wenhao set an ambush and broke the court army at Zaojia Bridge, advancing straight to the Zhuque Floating Bridge; Wang Daolong and Liu Mian both fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 初，勉高尚其意，托造園宅，名為「東山」，頗忽時務。

translations.literal: At first Liu Mian held his intent in high esteem, feigning to build gardens and residences named "Eastern Mountain," quite neglecting affairs of the time.
translations.idiomatic: At first Liu Mian held his intent in high esteem, feigning to build gardens and residences named "Eastern Mountain," quite neglecting affairs of the time.

sentences.zh: 帝謂曰：「將軍以顧命之重，此是艱難之日，而深尚從容，廢省羽翼，一朝事至，悔可追乎！

translations.literal: The emperor said to him: "General, with the weight of a deathbed charge — this is a day of hardship — yet you deeply esteem ease and neglect your wings; when the matter comes, can regret be pursued!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to him, "General, with the weight of a deathbed charge — this is a day of hardship — yet you deeply esteem ease and neglect your wings; when crisis comes, can regret be pursued?

sentences.zh: 」勉不納，竟敗。

translations.literal: " Liu Mian did not accept this and in the end was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: " Liu Mian did not accept this counsel and in the end was defeated.

sentences.zh: 及賊進至杜姥宅，車騎典簽茅恬開東府納賊，冠軍將軍沈懷明於石頭奔散，張永潰于白下，宮內傳新亭亦陷，太后執蒼梧王手泣曰：「天下事敗矣。

translations.literal: When the rebels advanced to Old Woman Du's residence, Cavalry and Chariots Registry Clerk Mao Tian opened the Eastern Palace to admit the rebels; Champion General Shen Huaiming scattered in flight at Shitou, Zhang Yong broke at Baixia, and within the palace it was reported that Xinting too had fallen; the empress dowager took Deposed Emperor Cangwu by the hand and wept: "The affairs of the realm are ruined.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels advanced to Old Woman Du's residence, Mao Tian, Cavalry and Chariots Registry Clerk, opened the Eastern Palace to admit the rebels; Champion General Shen Huaiming scattered in flight at Shitou, Zhang Yong broke at Baixia, and within the palace it was reported that Xinting too had fallen; the empress dowager took Deposed Emperor Cangwu by the hand and wept, "The affairs of the realm are ruined.

sentences.zh: 」帝遣軍主陳顯達、任農夫、張敬兒、周盤龍等從石頭濟淮，間道自承明門入衛宮闕。

translations.literal: " The emperor sent army commanders Chen Xianda, Ren Nongfu, Zhang Jing'er, Zhou Panlong and others to cross the Huai from Shitou by a hidden route and enter through Chenming Gate to guard the palace.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor sent army commanders Chen Xianda, Ren Nongfu, Zhang Jing'er, Zhou Panlong and others to cross the Huai from Shitou by a hidden route and enter through Chenming Gate to guard the palace.

sentences.zh: 時休范典簽許公與詐稱休範在新亭，士庶惶惑，詣壘期赴休範，投名者千數，及至，乃是帝。

translations.literal: At that time Xiufan's registry clerk Xu Gonghe falsely claimed that Xiufan was at Xinting; officials and commoners were alarmed and confused, going to the ramparts expecting to join Xiufan; those who submitted their names numbered in the thousands — when they arrived, it was the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xiufan's registry clerk Xu Gonghe falsely claimed that Xiufan was at Xinting; officials and commoners were alarmed and confused, going to the ramparts expecting to join Xiufan; those who submitted their names numbered in the thousands — when they arrived, it was the emperor.

sentences.zh: 隨得輒燒之。

translations.literal: As soon as he received them he burned them.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as he received them he burned them.

sentences.zh: 登城北謂曰：「劉休范父子先昨皆已死，戮屍在南岡下，身是蕭平南，諸君善見觀。

translations.literal: Ascending the city north he said: "Liu Xiufan father and son both died yesterday; their corpses were displayed below the southern ridge; I am Xiao Who Pacifies the South — all of you look well.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the northern wall he said, "Liu Xiufan father and son both died yesterday; their corpses were displayed below the southern ridge; I am Xiao Who Pacifies the South — all of you look well.

sentences.zh: 汝等名皆已焚除，勿懼也。

translations.literal: Your names have all been burned away — do not fear.
translations.idiomatic: Your names have all been burned away — do not fear.

sentences.zh: 」台分遣眾軍擊平賊，帝振旅凱入。

translations.literal: " The court dispatched the various armies to attack and pacify the rebels; the emperor led his troops in triumphant entry.
translations.idiomatic: " The court dispatched the various armies to attack and pacify the rebels; the emperor led his troops in triumphant entry.

sentences.zh: 百姓緣道聚觀，曰：「全國家者，此公也。

translations.literal: The common people lined the road to watch and said: "The one who saved the state is this lord.
translations.idiomatic: The common people lined the road to watch and said, "The one who saved the state is this lord.

sentences.zh: 」帝與袁粲、褚彥回、劉彥節引咎解職，不許。

translations.literal: " The emperor with Yuan Can, Chu Yanhui, and Liu Yanjie took blame and resigned their posts; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor with Yuan Can, Chu Yanhui, and Liu Yanjie took blame and resigned their posts; this was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 遷散騎常侍、中領軍、都督、南兗州刺史、鎮軍將軍，進爵為公。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Attendant Cavalier at Regular Attendance, Commander of the Palace Guard, Commander, Inspector of South Yan Province, and General Who Pacifies the Army; his rank was advanced to Duke.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Attendant Cavalier at Regular Attendance, Commander of the Palace Guard, Commander, Inspector of South Yan Province, and General Who Pacifies the Army; his rank was advanced to Duke.

sentences.zh: 與袁粲、褚彥回、劉彥節等更日入直決事，號為「四貴」。

translations.literal: With Yuan Can, Chu Yanhui, Liu Yanjie and others he alternated days entering attendance to decide affairs — they were called the "Four Nobles."
translations.idiomatic: With Yuan Can, Chu Yanhui, Liu Yanjie and others he alternated days entering attendance to decide affairs — they were called the "Four Nobles."

sentences.zh: 休范平後，蒼梧王漸行凶暴，屢欲害帝，嘗率數十人直入鎮軍府。

translations.literal: After Xiufan was pacified, Deposed Emperor Cangwu gradually acted with violent cruelty and repeatedly wished to harm the emperor; once he led several dozen men straight into the Army-pacifying Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: After Xiufan was pacified, Deposed Emperor Cangwu gradually acted with violent cruelty and repeatedly wished to harm the emperor; once he led several dozen men straight into the Army-pacifying Headquarters.

sentences.zh: 時暑熱，帝晝臥裸袒，蒼梧立帝於室內，畫腹為射的，自引滿，將射之。

translations.literal: It was hot at the time; the emperor slept by day bare-chested; Cangwu made the emperor stand in the room, drew his belly as an archery target, and himself drew the bow full, about to shoot.
translations.idiomatic: It was hot at the time; the emperor slept by day bare-chested; Cangwu made the emperor stand in the room, drew his belly as an archery target, and himself drew the bow full, about to shoot.

sentences.zh: 帝神色不變，斂板曰：「老臣無罪。

translations.literal: The emperor's expression did not change; he gathered his tablet and said: "This old minister is without guilt.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's expression did not change; he gathered his tablet and said, "This old minister is without guilt.

sentences.zh: 」蒼梧左右王天恩諫曰：「領軍腹大，是佳射堋，而一箭便死，後無復射，不如以雹箭射之。

translations.literal: " Cangwu's attendant Wang Tian'en remonstrated: "The commander's belly is large — it is an excellent archery butt; yet one arrow and he dies — afterward there will be no more shooting; better to shoot with a hail arrow.
translations.idiomatic: " Cangwu's attendant Wang Tian'en remonstrated, "The commander's belly is large — it is an excellent archery butt; yet one arrow and he dies — afterward there will be no more shooting; better to shoot with a hail arrow.

sentences.zh: 」乃取雹箭，一發即中帝臍。

translations.literal: " He then took a hail arrow; with one shot he hit the emperor's navel.
translations.idiomatic: " He then took a hail arrow; with one shot he hit the emperor's navel.

sentences.zh: 蒼梧投弓於地，大笑曰：「此手何如？

translations.literal: Cangwu threw the bow to the ground and laughed greatly: "How is this hand?
translations.idiomatic: Cangwu threw the bow to the ground and laughed greatly, "How is this hand?

sentences.zh: 」時建平王景素為朝野歸心，潛為自全計，布誠於帝，帝拒而不納。

translations.literal: " At that time Prince of Jianping Jingsu was the object of court and field hearts; secretly he made plans for self-preservation and showed sincerity to the emperor, but the emperor refused and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time Prince of Jianping Jingsu was the object of court and field hearts; secretly he made plans for self-preservation and showed sincerity to the emperor, but the emperor refused and did not accept.

sentences.zh: 景素尋舉兵，帝出屯玄武湖，事平乃還。

translations.literal: Jingsu soon raised troops; the emperor went out to encamp at Xuanwu Lake; when the affair was settled he returned.
translations.idiomatic: Jingsu soon raised troops; the emperor went out to encamp at Xuanwu Lake; when the affair was settled he returned.

sentences.zh: 帝威名既重，蒼梧深相猜忌，刻木為帝形，畫腹為射堋，自射之，又命左右，射中者加賞，皆莫能中。

translations.literal: The emperor's prestige and name were already weighty; Cangwu deeply suspected him; he carved wood in the emperor's shape, drew the belly as an archery butt, and shot at it himself; he also ordered his attendants — whoever hit received reward — yet none could hit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's prestige and name were already weighty; Cangwu deeply suspected him; he carved wood in the emperor's shape, drew the belly as an archery butt, and shot at it himself; he also ordered his attendants — whoever hit received reward — yet none could hit.

sentences.zh: 時帝在領軍府，蒼梧自來燒之，冀帝出，因作難，帝堅臥不動。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor was at the Palace Guard Headquarters; Cangwu came himself to burn it, hoping the emperor would come out so he could make trouble; the emperor lay firm and did not move.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor was at the Palace Guard Headquarters; Cangwu came himself to burn it, hoping the emperor would come out so he could make trouble; the emperor lay firm and did not move.

sentences.zh: 蒼梧益懷忿恚，所見之物，呼之為帝。

translations.literal: Cangwu grew ever more resentful and wrathful; whatever he saw he called "emperor."
translations.idiomatic: Cangwu grew ever more resentful and wrathful; whatever he saw he called "emperor."

sentences.zh: 加以手自磨鋋，曰：「明日當以刃蕭道成。

translations.literal: Moreover with his own hand he sharpened a blade and said: "Tomorrow I shall use the blade on Xiao Daocheng.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover with his own hand he sharpened a blade and said, "Tomorrow I shall use the blade on Xiao Daocheng.

sentences.zh: 」陳太妃罵之曰：「蕭道成有大功于國，今害之，誰為汝盡力？

translations.literal: " Consort Chen the Imperial Lady reviled him: "Xiao Daocheng has great merit for the state — now if you harm him, who will strive for you?
translations.idiomatic: " Consort Chen the Imperial Lady reviled him, "Xiao Daocheng has great merit for the state — now if you harm him, who will strive for you?

sentences.zh: 」故止。

translations.literal: " Therefore he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " Therefore he stopped.

sentences.zh: 高帝謀與袁褚廢立，皆不見從。

translations.literal: Emperor Gao plotted with Yuan and Chu to depose and establish, but all were not followed.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gao plotted with Yuan and Chu to depose and establish a new ruler, but none would follow.

sentences.zh: 五年七月戊子，楊玉夫等與直合將軍王敬則通謀弑蒼梧。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, on wuzi, Yang Yufu and others together with Direct Palace Gate General Wang Jingze conspired to assassinate Cangwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year, on wuzi, Yang Yufu and others together with Direct Palace Gate General Wang Jingze conspired to assassinate Cangwu.

sentences.zh: 齎首，使左右陳奉伯藏衣袖中，依常行法稱敕開承明門，出囊貯之，以與敬則。

translations.literal: Carrying the head, he had attendant Chen Fengbo hide it in his sleeve; according to the usual procedure he proclaimed the edict and opened Chenming Gate, took the sack and stored it, and gave it to Jingze.
translations.idiomatic: Carrying the head, he had attendant Chen Fengbo hide it in his sleeve; according to the usual procedure he proclaimed the edict and opened Chenming Gate, took the sack and stored it, and gave it to Jingze.

sentences.zh: 敬則馳至領軍府，叩門大呼，自言報帝，門猶不開，敬則自門窐中以首見帝，帝猶不信，乃於牆上投進其首，帝索水洗視，敬則乃踰垣入。

translations.literal: Jingze galloped to the Palace Guard Headquarters, knocked and shouted greatly, himself saying he reported to the emperor; the gate still did not open; Jingze from the gate hole showed his head to the emperor; the emperor still did not believe; then over the wall he threw in the head; the emperor asked for water to wash and look; Jingze then climbed over the wall and entered.
translations.idiomatic: Jingze galloped to the Palace Guard Headquarters, knocked and shouted greatly, saying he came to report to the emperor; the gate still did not open; Jingze from the gate hole showed his head to the emperor; the emperor still did not believe; then over the wall he threw in the head; the emperor asked for water to wash and look; Jingze then climbed over the wall and entered.

sentences.zh: 帝跣出，敬則叫曰：「事平矣。

translations.literal: The emperor barefoot went out; Jingze cried: "The affair is settled.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor barefoot went out; Jingze cried, "The affair is settled.

sentences.zh: 」帝乃戎服，乘常所騎赤馬，夜入殿中，殿中驚怖；

translations.literal: " The emperor then donned military dress, rode his usual red horse, and entered the palace by night; within the hall all were alarmed and terrified;
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor then donned military dress, rode his usual red horse, and entered the palace by night; within the hall all were alarmed and terrified;

sentences.zh: 及知蒼梧死，咸稱萬歲。

translations.literal: when they knew Cangwu was dead, all called "ten thousand years."
translations.idiomatic: when they learned Cangwu was dead, all cried "ten thousand years."

sentences.zh: 至帝踐阼，號此馬為「龍驤赤」。

translations.literal: When the emperor ascended the throne, this horse was titled "Dragon Cavalry Red."
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor ascended the throne, this horse was titled "Dragon Cavalry Red."

sentences.zh: 明旦，召袁粲、褚彥回、劉彥節入會西鍾槐樹下計議。

translations.literal: At dawn he summoned Yuan Can, Chu Yanhui, and Liu Yanjie to meet west of the Bell Pagoda Tree to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn he summoned Yuan Can, Chu Yanhui, and Liu Yanjie to meet west of the Bell Pagoda Tree to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 帝以事讓彥節，彥節未答。

translations.literal: The emperor yielded the affair to Yanjie; Yanjie did not reply.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor yielded the affair to Yanjie; Yanjie did not reply.

sentences.zh: 帝須髯盡張，眼光如電。

translations.literal: The emperor's beard bristled fully; his eye-glance was like lightning.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's beard bristled fully; his eye-glance was like lightning.

sentences.zh: 次讓袁粲，又不受。

translations.literal: Next he yielded to Yuan Can; again he did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Next he yielded to Yuan Can; again he did not accept.

sentences.zh: 敬則乃拔刀，在床側躍麾眾曰：「天下之事，皆應關蕭公，敢有開一言者，血染敬則刀！

translations.literal: Jingze then drew his sword, leaped beside the couch and waved to the crowd: "The affairs of the realm should all concern Lord Xiao — whoever dares open his mouth, blood will stain Jingze's blade!
translations.idiomatic: Jingze then drew his sword, leaped beside the couch and waved to the crowd, "The affairs of the realm should all concern Lord Xiao — whoever dares open his mouth, blood will stain Jingze's blade!

sentences.zh: 」仍呼虎賁劍戟羽儀，手自取白紗帽加帝首，令帝即位，曰：「今日誰敢復動，事須及熱。

translations.literal: " He then called the Tiger Guard with swords, halberds and feather regalia, personally took the white gauze cap and placed it on the emperor's head, ordered the emperor to ascend the throne, and said: "Today who dares move again — the affair must be done while it is hot.
translations.idiomatic: " He then called the Tiger Guard with swords, halberds and feather regalia, personally took the white gauze cap and placed it on the emperor's head, ordered the emperor to ascend the throne, and said, "Today who dares move again — the affair must be done while it is hot.

sentences.zh: 」帝正色呵之曰：「卿都不自解。

translations.literal: " The emperor with stern countenance shouted at him: "You do not understand at all.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor with stern countenance shouted at him, "You do not understand at all.

sentences.zh: 」粲欲有言，敬則又叱之，乃止。

translations.literal: Can wished to speak; Jingze again shouted at him, and he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Can wished to speak; Jingze again shouted at him, and he stopped.

sentences.zh: 帝乃下議，備法駕，詣東城，迎立順帝。

translations.literal: The emperor then issued the proposal, prepared the imperial carriage, went to the Eastern Palace, and welcomed Emperor Shun to be established.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then issued the proposal, prepared the imperial carriage, went to the Eastern Palace, and welcomed Emperor Shun to be established.

sentences.zh: 於是長刀遮粲、彥節等，失色而去。

translations.literal: Thereupon long swords blocked Can, Yanjie and others; pale-faced they departed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon long swords blocked Can, Yanjie and others; pale-faced they departed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，帝移鎮東府，與袁粲、褚彥回、劉彥節各甲仗五十人入殿。

translations.literal: On jiawu the emperor moved his garrison to the Eastern Palace; with Yuan Can, Chu Yanhui, and Liu Yanjie each fifty men in armor entered the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the emperor moved his garrison to the Eastern Palace; with Yuan Can, Chu Yanhui, and Liu Yanjie each fifty men in armor entered the hall.

sentences.zh: 丙申，加侍中、司空、錄尚書事、驃騎大將軍，封竟陵郡公，給油幢絡車，班劍三十人。

translations.literal: On bingshen he was promoted to Palace Attendant, Minister of Works, Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, and Grand General of Agile Cavalry; he was enfeoffed as Duke of Jingling Commandery, given an oil-canopied relay carriage and thirty swords of office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he was promoted to Palace Attendant, Minister of Works, Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, and Grand General of Agile Cavalry; he was enfeoffed as Duke of Jingling Commandery, given an oil-canopied relay carriage and thirty swords of office.

sentences.zh: 帝固辭上臺，即授以驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: The emperor firmly declined ascending the platform; he was immediately granted Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon of the First Order.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor firmly declined ascending the platform; he was immediately granted Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon of the First Order.

sentences.zh: 十二月，荊州刺史沈攸之反，稱太后詔己下都。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Inspector of Jing Province Shen Youzhi rebelled, claiming an edict of the empress dowager ordering him down to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Shen Youzhi, Inspector of Jing Province, rebelled, claiming an edict of the empress dowager ordering him down to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，帝入居朝堂，命諸將西討，平西將軍黃回為都督前驅。

translations.literal: On dingmao the emperor entered and resided in the Court Hall, ordered the various generals on the western campaign, and made General Who Pacifies the West Huang Hui commander of the vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor entered and resided in the Court Hall, ordered the various generals on the western campaign, and made Huang Hui, General Who Pacifies the West, commander of the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 先是，太后兄子前湘州刺史王蘊，遭母喪罷任，還至巴陵，停舟與攸之密謀，乃下達郢州。

translations.literal: Before this, the empress dowager's elder brother's son, former Inspector of Xiang Province Wang Yun, having met with his mother's mourning was dismissed from office; returning to Baling he moored his boat and secretly plotted with Youzhi, then descended to Ying Province.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, the empress dowager's elder brother's son, former Inspector of Xiang Province Wang Yun, having met with his mother's mourning was dismissed from office; returning to Baling he moored his boat and secretly plotted with Youzhi, then descended to Ying Province.

sentences.zh: 武帝時為郢州長史，蘊伺武帝出吊，因作亂，據郢城。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Wu was Chief Clerk of Ying Province; Yun watched for the emperor to go out on mourning visit and thereby made disorder, seizing Ying city.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Emperor Wu was Chief Clerk of Ying Province; Yun watched for the emperor to go out on a mourning visit and thereby made disorder, seizing Ying city.

sentences.zh: 武帝知之，不出。

translations.literal: The emperor knew it and did not go out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor knew of it and did not go out.

sentences.zh: 蘊還至東府前，又期見高帝，帝又不出吊。

translations.literal: Yun returned before the Eastern Palace gate and again arranged to see Emperor Gao; the emperor again did not go out on mourning visit.
translations.idiomatic: Yun returned before the Eastern Palace gate and again arranged to see Emperor Gao; the emperor again did not go out on a mourning visit.

sentences.zh: 再計不行，外謀愈固。

translations.literal: When the second plan failed, the external plot grew firmer.
translations.idiomatic: When the second plan failed, the external plot grew firmer.

sentences.zh: 司徒袁粲、尚書令劉彥節見帝威權稍盛，慮不自安，與蘊及黃回等相結舉事，殿內宿衛主帥無不協同。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Yuan Can and Director of the Department of State Affairs Liu Yanjie saw the emperor's authority gradually waxing and feared they would not be secure; with Yun and Huang Hui and others they joined in raising an affair — within the palace the garrison commanders without exception were in accord.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Yuan Can and Director of the Department of State Affairs Liu Yanjie saw the emperor's authority gradually waxing and feared they would not be secure; with Yun and Huang Hui and others they joined in raising an affair — within the palace the garrison commanders without exception were in accord.

sentences.zh: 及攸之反問初至，帝往石頭詣粲謀，粲稱疾不相見，克壬申夜起兵據石頭。

translations.literal: When Youzhi's first report of rebellion arrived, the emperor went to Shitou to consult with Can; Can claimed illness and would not meet; on the night of renshen he raised troops and seized Shitou.
translations.idiomatic: When Youzhi's first report of rebellion arrived, the emperor went to Shitou to consult with Can; Can claimed illness and would not meet; on the night of renshen he raised troops and seized Shitou.

sentences.zh: 其夜丹陽丞王遜告變。

translations.literal: That night Assistant Magistrate of Danyang Wang Xun reported the change.
translations.idiomatic: That night Wang Xun, Assistant Magistrate of Danyang, reported the change.

sentences.zh: 彥節從弟領軍韞及直合將軍卜伯興等嚴兵為內應，帝命王敬則于宮內誅之。

translations.literal: Yanjie's younger cousin from the mother's side, Commander of the Palace Guard Yun, and Direct Palace Gate General Bu Boxing and others held troops in strict readiness as internal response; the emperor ordered Wang Jingze within the palace to execute them.
translations.idiomatic: Yanjie's younger cousin from the mother's side, Commander of the Palace Guard Yun, and Direct Palace Gate General Bu Boxing and others held troops in strict readiness as internal response; the emperor ordered Wang Jingze within the palace to execute them.

sentences.zh: 遣諸將攻石頭，王蘊將數百精手，帶甲赴粲，城門已閉，官軍又至，乃散。

translations.literal: He dispatched the various generals to attack Shitou; Wang Yun led several hundred picked men in armor to join Can; the city gate was already closed and the official army had also arrived — they then scattered.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched the various generals to attack Shitou; Wang Yun led several hundred picked men in armor to join Can; the city gate was already closed and the official army had also arrived — they then scattered.

sentences.zh: 眾軍攻石頭，斬粲，彥節走額擔湖，蘊逃鬥場，並禽斬之。

translations.literal: The mass of armies attacked Shitou, beheaded Can; Yanjie fled to E'dan Lake, Yun escaped to the drill ground — both were captured and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: The mass of armies attacked Shitou and beheaded Can; Yanjie fled to E'dan Lake, Yun escaped to the drill ground — both were captured and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 粲典簽莫嗣祖同粲謀，蘊嬖人張承伯藏匿蘊，高帝亦並赦而用之。

translations.literal: Can's registry clerk Mo Sizu plotted with Can; Yun's favorite Zhang Chengbó hid Yun; Emperor Gao also pardoned and employed them all.
translations.idiomatic: Can's registry clerk Mo Sizu plotted with Can; Yun's favorite Zhang Chengbó hid Yun; Emperor Gao also pardoned and employed them all.

sentences.zh: 時黃回頓新亭，聞石頭已下，因稱救援，高帝知而不言，撫之愈厚，遣回西上，流涕告別。

translations.literal: At that time Huang Hui halted at Xinting; hearing Shitou had fallen, he then claimed to come to the rescue; Emperor Gao knew but did not speak, treated him ever more generously, and sent Hui west — parting with tears.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Huang Hui halted at Xinting; hearing Shitou had fallen, he then claimed to come to the rescue; Emperor Gao knew but did not speak, treated him ever more generously, and sent Hui west — parting with tears.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，沈攸之平。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, Shen Youzhi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, Shen Youzhi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 二月，宋帝進高帝太尉，都督十六州諸軍事，高帝表送黃鉞。

translations.literal: In the second month, the Song emperor promoted Emperor Gao to Grand Commandant, Commander of the Military Affairs of Sixteen Provinces; Emperor Gao submitted a memorial returning the yellow axe.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Song emperor promoted Emperor Gao to Grand Commandant, Commander of the Military Affairs of Sixteen Provinces; Emperor Gao submitted a memorial returning the yellow axe.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，增班劍四十人、甲仗百人入殿。

translations.literal: On the third month, on jiyou, he was given forty additional swords of office and a hundred men in armor entering the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the third month, he was given forty additional swords of office and a hundred men in armor entering the hall.

sentences.zh: 丙子，加羽葆、鼓吹。

translations.literal: On bingzi he was given feather parasols and drums and flutes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he was given feather parasols and drums and flutes.

sentences.zh: 大明、泰始以來，相承奢侈，百姓成俗，及高帝輔政，奏罷禦府，省二尚方諸飾玩，至是，又上表禁人間華偽雜物，凡十七條。

translations.literal: From the Daming and Taishi eras onward, extravagance was handed down and the common people made it custom; when Emperor Gao assisted in government he memorialized to abolish the imperial workshops and reduce the two Directorates of Works' ornamental playthings; now again he submitted a memorial forbidding among the people flashy false miscellaneous goods — seventeen articles in all.
translations.idiomatic: From the Daming and Taishi eras onward, extravagance was handed down and the common people made it custom; when Emperor Gao assisted in government he memorialized to abolish the imperial workshops and reduce the two Directorates of Works' ornamental playthings; now again he submitted a memorial forbidding among the people flashy false miscellaneous goods — seventeen articles in all.

sentences.zh: 其中宮及諸王服用，雖依舊例，亦請詳制。

translations.literal: For the inner palace and the various princes' dress and use, though following the old examples, he also requested detailed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: For the inner palace and the various princes' dress and use, though following the old examples, he also requested detailed regulation.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，加帝假黃鉞、都督中外諸軍事、太傅，領揚州牧，劍履上殿，入朝不趨，贊拜不名，置左右長史、司馬、從事中郎、掾、屬各四人。

translations.literal: On the ninth month, on bingwu, the emperor was given acting yellow axe, Commander of Central and External Military Affairs, Grand Tutor, Governor of Yang Province, sword and shoes in the hall, no hurrying in court entry, no name in congratulatory bows, with Left and Right Chief Clerks, Majors, Attendants, Secretaries, and Aides four each.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the ninth month, the emperor was given acting yellow axe, Commander of Central and External Military Affairs, Grand Tutor, Governor of Yang Province, sword and shoes in the hall, no hurrying in court entry, no name in congratulatory bows, with Left and Right Chief Clerks, Majors, Attendants, Secretaries, and Aides four each.

sentences.zh: 固辭，詔遣敦勸，乃受黃鉞，辭殊禮。

translations.literal: He firmly declined; an edict sent earnest urging and he then accepted the yellow axe, declining the special honors.
translations.idiomatic: He firmly declined; an edict sent earnest urging and he then accepted the yellow axe, declining the special honors.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，給三望車。

translations.literal: On jiayin he was given three relay carriages for viewing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he was given three relay carriages for viewing.

sentences.zh: 三年正月乙巳，高帝表蠲百姓逋責。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, on yisi, Emperor Gao submitted a memorial remitting the people's overdue taxes.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, on yisi, Emperor Gao submitted a memorial remitting the people's overdue taxes.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，加前部羽葆、鼓吹。

translations.literal: On bingchen he was given front feather parasols and drums and flutes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he was given front feather parasols and drums and flutes.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命太傅府依舊辟召。

translations.literal: On dingsi the Grand Tutor's office was ordered to recruit as before.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Grand Tutor's office was ordered to recruit as before.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，給高帝甲仗五百人，出入殿省。

translations.literal: On dingmao Emperor Gao was given five hundred men in armor, entering and leaving the halls and secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Emperor Gao was given five hundred men in armor, entering and leaving the halls and secretariat.

sentences.zh: 甲午，重申前命，劍履上殿，入朝不趨，贊拜不名。

translations.literal: On jiawu the previous command was reiterated: sword and shoes in the hall, no hurrying in court entry, no name in congratulatory bows.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the previous command was reiterated: sword and shoes in the hall, no hurrying in court entry, no name in congratulatory bows.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，宋帝詔進帝位相國，總百揆，封十郡為齊公，備九錫禮，加遠遊冠，位在諸侯王上，加相國綠綟綬。

translations.literal: On the third month, on jiachen, the Song emperor edicted advancing the emperor's rank to Chancellor of State, overseeing all affairs, enfeoffing ten commanderies as Duke of Qi, with the full Nine Bestowals, the far-traveling cap, rank above all feudal princes, with the Chancellor of State's green cord and ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the third month, the Song emperor edicted advancing the emperor's rank to Chancellor of State, overseeing all affairs, enfeoffing ten commanderies as Duke of Qi, with the full Nine Bestowals, the far-traveling cap, rank above all feudal princes, with the Chancellor of State's green cord and ribbon.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，使以

translations.literal: On jiayin, he sent with
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, he sent with

sentences.zh: 備物典禮進，策曰：

translations.literal: the prepared objects and ceremonial protocol to advance, the edict saying:
translations.idiomatic: the prepared objects and ceremonial protocol to advance, the edict saying:

sentences.zh: 朕以不造，夙罹閔凶，嗣君失德，書契未紀，威侮五行，虔劉九縣，神歇靈繹，海水群飛，綴旒之殆，未足為譬，豈直小宛興刺，黍離作歌而已哉。

translations.literal: I by misfortune from youth suffered bereavement; the succeeding ruler lost virtue; the written covenant was not recorded; he wantonly insulted the Five Elements and cruelly harmed the nine districts; spirits ceased and numen broke; the sea's waters flew in flocks; the peril of the dangling tassel was not enough for comparison — how could it be only the "Little Odes" raising reproof and "Fallen Grain" making song!
translations.idiomatic: I by misfortune from youth suffered bereavement; the succeeding ruler lost virtue; the written covenant was not recorded; he wantonly insulted the Five Elements and cruelly harmed the nine districts; spirits ceased and numen broke; the sea's waters flew in flocks; the peril of the dangling tassel was not enough for comparison — how could it be only the "Little Odes" raising reproof and "Fallen Grain" making song!

sentences.zh: 天贊皇宋，實啟明宰，爰登寡昧，纂承大業，高勳至德，振古絕倫，雖保衡翼殷，博陸匡漢，方斯蔑如也。

translations.literal: Heaven assisted Great Song and truly opened the bright minister; I ascended the dim and ignorant and inherited the great enterprise; his high merit and supreme virtue shake antiquity and stand alone — though the Protector of Yin winged Yin and the Broad-landed steadied Han, compared with this they are as nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven assisted Great Song and truly opened the bright minister; I ascended the dim and ignorant and inherited the great enterprise; his high merit and supreme virtue shake antiquity and stand alone — though the Protector of Yin winged Yin and the Broad-landed steadied Han, compared with this they are as nothing.

sentences.zh: 今將授公典禮，其敬聽朕命：

translations.literal: Now I shall confer on you the ceremonial protocol — respectfully hear my command:
translations.idiomatic: Now I shall confer on you the ceremonial protocol — respectfully hear my command:

sentences.zh: 乃者袁、鄧構禍，實繁有徒，子房不臣，稱兵協亂，顧瞻宮掖，將成茂草，言念邦國，翦為仇讎。

translations.literal: Recently Yuan and Deng raised calamity — truly a multitude of followers; Zifang was disloyal, called out troops and joined disorder; looking back at the palace quarters, they were about to become overgrown grass; speaking of the state, it was cut to become mutual foes.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Yuan and Deng raised calamity — truly a multitude of followers; Zifang was disloyal, called out troops and joined disorder; looking back at the palace quarters, they were about to become overgrown grass; speaking of the state, it was cut to become mutual foes.

sentences.zh: 當此之時，人無固志。

translations.literal: At that time men had no fixed will.
translations.idiomatic: At that time men had no fixed will.

sentences.zh: 公投袂徇難，超然奮發，登寅車而戒路，執金板而先驅，麾鉞一臨，凶黨冰泮，此則霸業之基，勤王之始也。

translations.literal: You rolled up your sleeves to follow difficulty, transcendent and roused to action; ascended the yin chariot and warned the road; held the golden board and went as vanguard; when the axe-banner was once deployed, the villainous faction melted like ice — this then was the foundation of hegemony, the beginning of aiding the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: You rolled up your sleeves to follow difficulty, transcendent and roused to action; ascended the yin chariot and warned the road; held the golden board and went as vanguard; when the axe-banner was once deployed, the villainous faction melted like ice — this then was the foundation of hegemony, the beginning of aiding the ruler.

sentences.zh: 安都背叛，竊據徐方，敢率犬羊，陵虐淮浦。

translations.literal: An Du rebelled and secretly held Xu Region, daring to lead dogs and goats to bully and abuse the Huai shore.
translations.idiomatic: An Du rebelled and secretly held Xu Region, daring to lead dogs and goats to bully and abuse the Huai shore.

sentences.zh: 索兒愚悖，同惡相濟，天祚無象，背順歸逆，北鄙黔黎，奄墜塗炭。

translations.literal: Suo'er was foolish and perverse, together with evil they aided each other; Heaven's blessing had no sign; turning from obedience they returned to rebellion; the black-haired folk of the northern frontier suddenly fell into smeared charcoal.
translations.idiomatic: Suo'er was foolish and perverse, together with evil they aided each other; Heaven's blessing had no sign; turning from obedience they returned to rebellion; the black-haired folk of the northern frontier suddenly fell into smeared charcoal.

sentences.zh: 公受命宗祊，精貫朝日，擁節和門，氣踰霄漢，破釜之捷，斬馘蔽野，石梁之戰，禽其渠帥，保境全人，江陽即序，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: You received the mandate of the ancestral temple; spirit pierced the morning sun; bearing the staff at the Harmonious Gate, spirit exceeded the Milky Way; the victory at Pofu, heads and ears covered the wilds; the battle at Shiliang, captured their chieftains; protected the borders and preserved the people; Ji and Yang were then ordered — this again was your merit.
translations.idiomatic: You received the mandate of the ancestral temple; spirit pierced the morning sun; bearing the staff at the Harmonious Gate, spirit exceeded the Milky Way; the victory at Pofu, heads and ears covered the wilds; the battle at Shiliang, captured their chieftains; protected the borders and preserved the people; Ji and Yang were then ordered — this again was your merit.

sentences.zh: 張淹迷昧，弗顧本朝，爰自南區，志圖東夏，潛軍間入，竊覬不虞。

translations.literal: Zhang Yan was deluded and blind, not considering the court; from the southern region he secretly sent troops by hidden entry, secretly looking for the unprepared.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yan was deluded and blind, not considering the court; from the southern region he secretly sent troops by hidden entry, secretly looking for the unprepared.

sentences.zh: 于時江服未夷，皇塗薦沮，公忠誠慷慨，在險彌亮，以寡制眾，所向風偃，朝廷無東顧之憂，閩、越有來蘇之慶，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: At that time the Yangtze service was not yet pacified and the imperial road was repeatedly obstructed; you were loyal and ardent, in danger ever brighter; with the few controlling the many, wherever you went the wind lay down; the court had no worry of looking east; Min and Yue had the joy of returning to life — this again was your merit.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Yangtze service was not yet pacified and the imperial road was repeatedly obstructed; you were loyal and ardent, in danger ever brighter; with the few controlling the many, wherever you went the wind lay down; the court had no worry of looking east; Min and Yue had the joy of returning to life — this again was your merit.

sentences.zh: 匈奴野心，侵掠疆埸，醜羯侜張，勢振彭、泗。

translations.literal: The Xiongnu had wild hearts and invaded the borders; the ugly Jie were arrogant and their power shook Peng and Si.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiongnu had wild hearts and invaded the borders; the ugly Jie were arrogant and their power shook Peng and Si.

sentences.zh: 公奉辭伐罪，戒旦晨征，兵車始交，氛祲時蕩，吊死扶傷，弘宣皇澤，俾我淮、肥，復沾盛化，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: You received the charge to punish crime, warned at dawn and marched at morning; when war chariots first met, the baleful vapors were immediately dispersed; mourning the dead and supporting the wounded, you broadly proclaimed the imperial grace; causing our Huai and Fei again to be moistened by flourishing transformation — this again was your merit.
translations.idiomatic: You received the charge to punish crime, warned at dawn and marched at morning; when war chariots first met, the baleful vapors were immediately dispersed; mourning the dead and supporting the wounded, you broadly proclaimed the imperial grace; causing our Huai and Fei again to be moistened by flourishing transformation — this again was your merit.

sentences.zh: 自茲厥後，獫狁孔熾，封豕長蛇，重窺上國。

translations.literal: From then onward the Xianyun were greatly rampant; the sealed boar and long snake again looked upon the upper state.
translations.idiomatic: From then onward the Xianyun were greatly rampant; the sealed boar and long snake again looked upon the upper state.

sentences.zh: 而世故相仍，師出已老，角城高壘，指日淪陷。

translations.literal: Yet worldly affairs continued in succession; the army went out already aged; Jiaocheng's high ramparts on the appointed day fell.
translations.idiomatic: Yet worldly affairs continued in succession; the army went out already aged; Jiaocheng's high ramparts on the appointed day fell.

sentences.zh: 公眷言王事，發憤忘食，躬擐甲胄，視險若夷，分疆畫界，開創青、兗，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: You mindful of the king's affair, roused anger and forgot food; personally donned armor; regarded danger as level ground; divided borders and drew boundaries; opened and created Qing and Yan — this again was your merit.
translations.idiomatic: You mindful of the king's affair, roused anger and forgot food; personally donned armor; regarded danger as level ground; divided borders and drew boundaries; opened and created Qing and Yan — this again was your merit.

sentences.zh: 桂陽負眾，輕問九鼎，裂冠毀冕，拔本塞源，烈火焚于王城，飛矢集乎君屋，群後憂惶，元戎無主。

translations.literal: Guiyang relied on the multitude, lightly questioned the Nine Cauldrons; tore cap and destroyed crown, uprooted root and blocked source; fierce fire burned at the royal city; flying arrows gathered at the lord's house; the various ministers were anxious and terrified; the grand commander had no master.
translations.idiomatic: Guiyang relied on the multitude, lightly questioned the Nine Cauldrons; tore cap and destroyed crown, uprooted root and blocked source; fierce fire burned at the royal city; flying arrows gathered at the lord's house; the various ministers were anxious and terrified; the grand commander had no master.

sentences.zh: 公按劍凝神，則奇謨冠世，把旄指麾，則懦夫成勇，信宿之間，宣陽底定，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: You grasped the sword and concentrated spirit — then wondrous plans crowned the age; held the banner and commanded — then cowards became brave; within a night and a day, Xuanyang was settled at the bottom — this again was your merit.
translations.idiomatic: You grasped the sword and concentrated spirit — then wondrous plans crowned the age; held the banner and commanded — then cowards became brave; within a night and a day, Xuanyang was settled at the bottom — this again was your merit.

sentences.zh: 皇室多難，釁起戚藩，建平失圖，興兵內侮，公指授六師，義形於色，役未踰旬，朱方甯晏，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: The imperial house had many difficulties; trouble arose from kin princes; Jianping lost plan and raised troops to insult within; you directed the Six Armies, righteousness showed in your countenance; the service did not exceed ten days and Zhufang was then tranquil — this again was your merit.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial house had many difficulties; trouble arose from kin princes; Jianping lost plan and raised troops to insult within; you directed the Six Armies, righteousness showed in your countenance; the service did not exceed ten days and Zhufang was then tranquil — this again was your merit.

sentences.zh: 蒼梧肆虐，諸夏糜沸，淫刑以逞，誰則無辜，黔首相悲，朝不謀夕，高祖之業已淪，文、明之軌誰嗣。

translations.literal: Cangwu acted with violent cruelty; the various Xia boiled over; licentious punishments to show power — who then was without guilt; black-haired heads mutually grieved; the court did not plan for tomorrow; the High Ancestor's enterprise already sank; who would succeed the track of Wen and Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Cangwu acted with violent cruelty; the various Xia boiled over; licentious punishments to show power — who then was without guilt; black-haired heads mutually grieved; the court did not plan for tomorrow; the High Ancestor's enterprise already sank; who would succeed the track of Wen and Ming.

sentences.zh: 公遠稽殷、漢之義，近遵魏、晉之典，猥以眇身，入奉宗祏，七廟清謐，九區反政，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: You distantly examined the righteousness of Yin and Han, nearly followed the statutes of Wei and Jin; humbly with this slight person entered to serve the ancestral tablet; the seven temples were clear and quiet; the nine regions returned to governance — this again was your merit.
translations.idiomatic: You distantly examined the righteousness of Yin and Han, nearly followed the statutes of Wei and Jin; humbly with this slight person entered to serve the ancestral tablet; the seven temples were clear and quiet; the nine regions returned to governance — this again was your merit.

sentences.zh: 袁、劉攜貳，成此亂階，醜圖潛溝，危機竊發，據有石頭，志犯應、路。

translations.literal: Yuan and Liu were double-hearted and made this disorderly step; ugly plots in hidden channels; crisis machine secretly sprang; they held Shitou and intended to violate Ying and Lu.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan and Liu were double-hearted and made this disorderly step; ugly plots in hidden channels; crisis machine secretly sprang; they held Shitou and intended to violate Ying and Lu.

sentences.zh: 公神謀內運，霜鋒外舉，祅沴載澄，國塗悅穆，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: Your divine plan operated within; frost blades raised without; demonic calamities were all cleared; the state's path was pleased and reverent — this again was your merit.
translations.idiomatic: Your divine plan operated within; frost blades raised without; demonic calamities were all cleared; the state's path was pleased and reverent — this again was your merit.

sentences.zh: 沈攸苞禍，歲月滋彰，蜂目豺聲，阻兵安忍，乃眷西顧，緬同異域。

translations.literal: Shen You harbored calamity; month and year ever more manifest; bee eyes and jackal voice; blocking troops and enduring cruelty; then looking west with fondness, far like a different realm.
translations.idiomatic: Shen You harbored calamity; month and year ever more manifest; bee eyes and jackal voice; blocking troops and enduring cruelty; then looking west with fondness, far like a different realm.

sentences.zh: 而經綸惟始，九伐未申，長惡不悛，遂逞凶逆。

translations.literal: Yet when planning and governing had just begun, the nine campaigns were not yet declared; long evil not repenting, then he displayed fierce rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when planning and governing had just begun, the nine campaigns were not yet declared; long evil not repenting, then he displayed fierce rebellion.

sentences.zh: 公把鉞出關，凝威江甸，正情與皦日同亮，明略與秋雲競爽，至義所感，人百其心，積年逋誅，一朝顯戮，沮浦安流，章台順軌，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: You held the axe and went out of the pass, congealed prestige in the river district; upright feeling was bright as the sun; clear strategy vied with autumn clouds; utmost righteousness moved men — each a hundred hearts; years of overdue punishment in one morning clearly executed; Zupu peacefully flowed; Zhang Terrace followed the track — this again was your merit.
translations.idiomatic: You held the axe and went out of the pass, congealed prestige in the river district; upright feeling was bright as the sun; clear strategy vied with autumn clouds; utmost righteousness moved men — each a hundred hearts; years of overdue punishment in one morning clearly executed; Zupu peacefully flowed; Zhang Terrace followed the track — this again was your merit.

sentences.zh: 公有濟天下之勳，重之以明哲，道庇生靈，志匡宇宙，戮力肆心，劬勞王室，險阻艱難，備嘗之矣。

translations.literal: You have merit saving the realm, heavy with enlightened wisdom; the Way shelters the living; the will rectifies the cosmos; together striving with all heart, laboring for the royal house; danger, obstruction, hardship — all have been tasted.
translations.idiomatic: You have merit saving the realm, heavy with enlightened wisdom; the Way shelters the living; the will rectifies the cosmos; together striving with all heart, laboring for the royal house; danger, obstruction, hardship — all have been tasted.

sentences.zh: 若乃締構宗稷之勤，造物資始之澤，雲布霧散，光被六幽，弼予一人，永清四海。

translations.literal: As for the diligence of founding the ancestral altar, the grace of creating and nourishing at the beginning — clouds spread and mist scattered, light covered the six depths; assisting me alone, forever clearing the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: As for the diligence of founding the ancestral altar, the grace of creating and nourishing at the beginning — clouds spread and mist scattered, light covered the six depths; assisting me alone, forever clearing the four seas.

sentences.zh: 是以秬草騰芳於郊園，景星垂暉於清漢，遐方款關而慕義，荒服重譯而來庭，汪哉邈乎，無得而名也。

translations.literal: Therefore the black millet wine rose fragrant in the suburban gardens; the auspicious star hung radiance in the clear Milky Way; distant regions knocked at the gate and admired righteousness; wild clothes through repeated translation came to the court — vast and far, there was no obtaining a name.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the black millet wine rose fragrant in the suburban gardens; the auspicious star hung radiance in the clear Milky Way; distant regions knocked at the gate and admired righteousness; wild clothes through repeated translation came to the court — vast and far, there was no obtaining a name.

sentences.zh: 朕聞疇庸表德，前王盛典，崇樹侯伯，有國攸同，所以文命成功，玄圭顯錫，姬旦宣哲，曲阜啟藩。

translations.literal: I have heard that recording merit and displaying virtue is the former kings' grand ceremony; honoring and establishing marquises and earls — the state has the same rule; therefore completing the mandate with culture, the dark jade was clearly bestowed; Duke of Zhou proclaimed wisdom and Qufu opened the fief.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that recording merit and displaying virtue is the former kings' grand ceremony; honoring and establishing marquises and earls — the state has the same rule; therefore completing the mandate with culture, the dark jade was clearly bestowed; Duke of Zhou proclaimed wisdom and Qufu opened the fief.

sentences.zh: 或改玉以弘風，或胙土以宣化，禮絕常班，寵冠群辟。

translations.literal: Some changed jade to spread the wind; some granted soil to proclaim transformation — ritual exceeded the usual ranks; favor crowned the group of lords.
translations.idiomatic: Some changed jade to spread the wind; some granted soil to proclaim transformation — ritual exceeded the usual ranks; favor crowned the group of lords.

sentences.zh: 爰逮桓、文，車服異數。

translations.literal: Down to Huan and Wen, carriage and dress had different numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Down to Huan and Wen, carriage and dress had different numbers.

sentences.zh: 惟公勳業超于先烈，而褒賞闕于舊章，古今之道，何其爽歟！

translations.literal: Only your achievement surpassed the bright ancestors, yet praise and reward lacked in the old statutes — the way of antiquity and present, how abrupt!
translations.idiomatic: Only your achievement surpassed the bright ancestors, yet praise and reward lacked in the old statutes — the way of antiquity and present, how abrupt!

sentences.zh: 靜言欽歎，良有缺然。

translations.literal: Quietly speaking, I admire and sigh — truly there is lack.
translations.idiomatic: Quietly speaking, I admire and sigh — truly there is lack.

sentences.zh: 今進授相國，以青州之齊郡、徐州之梁郡、南徐州之蘭陵魯郡琅邪東海晉陵義興、揚州之吳郡會稽，凡十郡，封公為齊公。

translations.literal: Now I advance and confer Chancellor of State, with Qi Commandery of Qing Province, Liang Commandery of Xu Province, Lanling, Lu, Langye, East Sea, Jinling, Yixing of South Xu Province, Wu and Kuaiji Commanderies of Yang Province — ten commanderies in all — and enfeoff you as Duke of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Now I advance and confer Chancellor of State, with Qi Commandery of Qing Province, Liang Commandery of Xu Province, Lanling, Lu, Langye, East Sea, Jinling, Yixing of South Xu Province, Wu and Kuaiji Commanderies of Yang Province — ten commanderies in all — and enfeoff you as Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 錫茲玄土，苴以白茅，定爾邦家，用建塚社。

translations.literal: Bestow this dark soil, wrap with white thatch, settle your state and house, thereby establish the altar of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow this dark soil, wrap with white thatch, settle your state and house, thereby establish the altar of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 斯實尚父故藩，世作盟主，紀綱侯甸，率由舊則。

translations.literal: This is truly the old fief of the Grand Mentor; generation after generation alliance lord; the threads of marquises and districts all follow the old rules.
translations.idiomatic: This is truly the old fief of the Grand Mentor; generation after generation alliance lord; the threads of marquises and districts all follow the old rules.

sentences.zh: 往者周、召建國，師保兼任，毛、畢執珪，入作卿士，內外之寵，同規在昔。

translations.literal: Formerly Zhou and Shao established states; teacher and protector jointly held office; Mao and Bi held the jade tablet and entered as ministers — internal and external favor, the same rule in the past.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Zhou and Shao established states; teacher and protector jointly held office; Mao and Bi held the jade tablet and entered as ministers — internal and external favor, the same rule in the past.

sentences.zh: 今命使持節、兼太尉、侍中、中書監、司空、衛將軍雩都縣開國侯彥回，授公相國印綬、齊公璽紱。

translations.literal: Now I command Bearer of the Staff, concurrent Grand Commandant, Palace Attendant, Director of the Palace Secretariat, Minister of Works, General Who Guards the Army, Marquis of Yudu County Yanhui, to confer on you the Chancellor of State's seal and cord and Duke of Qi's seal and ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: Now I command Bearer of the Staff, concurrent Grand Commandant, Palace Attendant, Director of the Palace Secretariat, Minister of Works, General Who Guards the Army, Marquis of Yudu County Yanhui, to confer on you the Chancellor of State's seal and cord and Duke of Qi's seal and ribbon.

sentences.zh: 持節、兼司空副、守尚書令僧虔授齊公茅土，金虎符第一至第五左，竹使符第一至第十左。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff, concurrent Vice Minister of Works, Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs Sengqian to confer Qi Duke's thatch and soil, Golden Tiger Tallies first through fifth left, Bamboo Envoys' Tallies first through tenth left.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff, concurrent Vice Minister of Works, Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs Sengqian to confer Qi Duke's thatch and soil, Golden Tiger Tallies first through fifth left, Bamboo Envoys' Tallies first through tenth left.

sentences.zh: 相國位總百辟，秩踰三事，職以禮移，號隨事革，其以相國總百揆，去錄尚書之稱，送所假節、侍中貂蟬、中外都督太傅太尉印綬、竟陵公印策，其驃騎大將軍、揚州牧、南徐州刺史如故。

translations.literal: The Chancellor of State's rank oversees all ministers; emolument exceeds the Three Dignitaries; office moves with ritual; title changes with affairs — with the Chancellor of State overseeing all affairs, remove the title Recorder of the Department of State Affairs; return the borrowed staff, Palace Attendant's sable cicada, Central and External Commander, Grand Tutor, Grand Commandant seals and cords, Duke of Jingling's seal and edict; Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Governor of Yang Province, Inspector of South Xu Province as before.
translations.idiomatic: The Chancellor of State's rank oversees all ministers; emolument exceeds the Three Dignitaries; office moves with ritual; title changes with affairs — with the Chancellor of State overseeing all affairs, remove the title Recorder of the Department of State Affairs; return the borrowed staff, Palace Attendant's sable cicada, Central and External Commander, Grand Tutor, Grand Commandant seals and cords, Duke of Jingling's seal and edict; Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Governor of Yang Province, Inspector of South Xu Province as before.

sentences.zh: 又加公九錫，其敬聽後命：

translations.literal: Also add to you the Nine Bestowals — respectfully hear the later command:
translations.idiomatic: Also add to you the Nine Bestowals — respectfully hear the later command:

sentences.zh: 以公執禮弘律、儀刑區宇、遐邇一體，人無異業。

translations.literal: Because you uphold ritual and broaden law, model punishment for the realm, far and near one body, men without different occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Because you uphold ritual and broaden law, model punishment for the realm, far and near one body, men without different occupations.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公大輅、戎輅各一，玄牡二駟。

translations.literal: Therefore bestow on you great carriage and war carriage one each, dark stallions two teams of four.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestow on you great carriage and war carriage one each, dark stallions two teams of four.

sentences.zh: 公崇修南畝，所寶惟谷，王府充實，百姓繁衍。

translations.literal: You honor and cultivate the southern fields; what you treasure is only grain; the royal storehouses are full and the common people multiply.
translations.idiomatic: You honor and cultivate the southern fields; what you treasure is only grain; the royal storehouses are full and the common people multiply.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公袞冕之服，赤舄副焉。

translations.literal: Therefore bestow on you robe and cap of honor, red shoes as supplement.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestow on you robe and cap of honor, red shoes as supplement.

sentences.zh: 公居身以謙，導物以義，鎔鈞庶品，罔不和悅。

translations.literal: You in person are with humility; you lead things with righteousness; the bell harmonizes the multitude — none not harmonious and pleased.
translations.idiomatic: You in person are with humility; you lead things with righteousness; the bell harmonizes the multitude — none not harmonious and pleased.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公軒縣之樂，六佾之舞。

translations.literal: Therefore bestow on you suspended music of the bell frame, dance of the six rows.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestow on you suspended music of the bell frame, dance of the six rows.

sentences.zh: 公翼贊王猷，聲教遠洽，蠻夷竭歡，回首內附。

translations.literal: You wing and assist the king's plan; fame and teaching reach far; barbarians exhaust joy and turn their heads to join within.
translations.idiomatic: You wing and assist the king's plan; fame and teaching reach far; barbarians exhaust joy and turn their heads to join within.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公朱戶以居。

translations.literal: Therefore bestow on you vermilion doors to dwell.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestow on you vermilion doors to dwell.

sentences.zh: 公明鑒人倫，澄辨涇、渭，官方與能，英乂克舉。

translations.literal: You clearly mirror human relations; clearly distinguish Jing and Wei; officials follow ability; heroes and worthies are raised.
translations.idiomatic: You clearly mirror human relations; clearly distinguish Jing and Wei; officials follow ability; heroes and worthies are raised.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公納陛以登。

translations.literal: Therefore bestow on you inner steps to ascend.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestow on you inner steps to ascend.

sentences.zh: 公保佑皇朝，厲身化下，杜漸防萌，含生寅式。

translations.literal: You protect and bless the imperial court; you discipline yourself to transform those below; stop gradual decay and prevent sprouting; all living things take you as model.
translations.idiomatic: You protect and bless the imperial court; you discipline yourself to transform those below; stop gradual decay and prevent sprouting; all living things take you as model.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公虎賁之士三百人。

translations.literal: Therefore bestow on you three hundred Tiger Guard warriors.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestow on you three hundred Tiger Guard warriors.

sentences.zh: 公禦宄以刑，禦奸以德，君親無將，將而必誅。
