translations.literal: You repel traitors with punishment, repel treachery with virtue; ruler and kin have no generals — if they become generals they must be executed.
translations.idiomatic: You repel traitors with punishment, repel treachery with virtue; ruler and kin have no generals — if they become generals they must be executed.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公鈇鉞各一。

translations.literal: Therefore bestow on you axe and yue one each.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestow on you axe and yue one each.

sentences.zh: 公鳳舉四維，龍騰八表，威靈所振，異類同乂。

translations.literal: You phoenix-rise in the four dimensions, dragon-soar in the eight directions; where prestige and spirit shake, different kinds are together governed.
translations.idiomatic: You phoenix-rise in the four dimensions, dragon-soar in the eight directions; where prestige and spirit shake, different kinds are together governed.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公彤弓一、彤矢百、盧弓十、盧矢千。

translations.literal: Therefore bestow on you red bow one, red arrows one hundred, black bow ten, black arrows one thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestow on you red bow one, red arrows one hundred, black bow ten, black arrows one thousand.

sentences.zh: 公明發載懷，肅恭禋祀，孝敬之重，義感靈只。

translations.literal: You at dawn cherish and hold, reverently perform the suburban sacrifice; the weight of filial respect moved the numinous spirits.
translations.idiomatic: You at dawn cherish and hold, reverently perform the suburban sacrifice; the weight of filial respect moved the numinous spirits.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公秬鬯一卣，圭瓚副焉。

translations.literal: Therefore bestow on you one jar of black millet wine, jade libation cup as supplement.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestow on you one jar of black millet wine, jade libation cup as supplement.

sentences.zh: 齊國置丞相以下，敬遵舊式。

translations.literal: Qi State shall establish Chancellor and below — respectfully follow the old forms.
translations.idiomatic: Qi State shall establish Chancellor and below — respectfully follow the old forms.

sentences.zh: 往欽哉，其祗服朕命，經緯乾坤，宏亮洪業，茂昭爾大德，闡揚我高祖之休命。

translations.literal: Go — reverently accept my command; weave and regulate Heaven and Earth; grandly illumine the great enterprise; abundantly display your great virtue; broadly raise our High Ancestor's beautiful mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Go — reverently accept my command; weave and regulate Heaven and Earth; grandly illumine the great enterprise; abundantly display your great virtue; broadly raise our High Ancestor's beautiful mandate.

sentences.zh: 高帝三讓，公卿敦勸固請，乃受之。

translations.literal: Emperor Gao thrice declined; the ministers earnestly urged and firmly requested — he then accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gao thrice declined; the ministers earnestly urged and firmly requested — he then accepted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，下令赦國內殊死以下。

translations.literal: On dingsi he issued an order pardoning within the state those guilty of special death and below.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he issued an order pardoning within the state those guilty of special death and below.

sentences.zh: 宋帝詔齊公十郡之外，隨宜除用。

translations.literal: The Song emperor edicted that beyond the Qi duke's ten commanderies, appointments might be made as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The Song emperor edicted that beyond the Qi duke's ten commanderies, appointments might be made as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 以齊國初建，給錢五百萬、布五千疋、絹五千疋。

translations.literal: Because Qi State was newly established, five million cash, five thousand bolts of cloth, and five thousand bolts of silk were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Because Qi State was newly established, five million cash, five thousand bolts of cloth, and five thousand bolts of silk were granted.

sentences.zh: 以太尉左長史王儉為尚書右僕射，領吏部。

translations.literal: Left Chief Clerk of the Grand Commandant Wang Jian was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, overseeing the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Left Chief Clerk of the Grand Commandant Wang Jian was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, overseeing the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 四月癸酉，宋帝又詔進齊公為王，以豫州之南梁陳潁川陳留、南兗州之盱眙山陽秦廣陵海陵南沛增王封為二十郡。

translations.literal: On the fourth month, on guiyou, the Song emperor again edicted advancing the Qi duke to king, adding South Liang, Chen, Yingchuan, Chenliu of Yu Province, and Xuyi, Shanyang, Qin, Guangling, Hailing, South Pei of South Yan Province — increasing the king's fief to twenty commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the fourth month, the Song emperor again edicted advancing the Qi duke to king, adding South Liang, Chen, Yingchuan, Chenliu of Yu Province, and Xuyi, Shanyang, Qin, Guangling, Hailing, South Pei of South Yan Province — increasing the king's fief to twenty commanderies.

sentences.zh: 使司空褚彥回奉策授璽紱，改立王社，餘如故。

translations.literal: He sent Minister of Works Chu Yanhui to present the edict and confer seal and ribbon, re-establish the king's altar of soil and grain; the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Minister of Works Chu Yanhui to present the edict and confer seal and ribbon, re-establish the king's altar of soil and grain; the rest as before.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命齊王冕十有二旒，建天子旌旗，出警入蹕，乘金根車，駕六馬，備五時副車，置旄頭、雲罕，樂舞八佾，設鍾虡宮縣，王世子為太子，王女、王孫爵命，一如舊儀。

translations.literal: On bingxu he commanded the Qi king's cap have twelve tassels, establish the Son of Heaven's banners, go out with police and enter with clearance, ride the golden-root carriage, drive six horses, prepare five seasonal secondary carriages, establish Máo-head and Cloud Banner, music and dance of eight rows, set bell stands and palace bells, the king's heir as crown prince, king's daughters and grandsons with ranks and commands all as the old ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he commanded the Qi king's cap have twelve tassels, establish the Son of Heaven's banners, go out with police and enter with clearance, ride the golden-root carriage, drive six horses, prepare five seasonal secondary carriages, establish Máo-head and Cloud Banner, music and dance of eight rows, set bell stands and palace bells, the king's heir as crown prince, king's daughters and grandsons with ranks and commands all as the old ritual.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，宋帝以歷數在齊，乃下詔禪位，是日遜于東邸。

translations.literal: On xinmao the Song emperor, because the succession was with Qi, then issued an edict abdicating; that day he yielded at the Eastern Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Song emperor, because the succession was with Qi, then issued an edict abdicating; that day he yielded at the Eastern Lodge.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣使奉策曰：

translations.literal: On renchen he dispatched envoys presenting the edict saying:
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he dispatched envoys presenting the edict saying:

sentences.zh: 咨爾齊王：伊太古初陳，萬化紛綸，開曜靈以鑒品物，立元後以馭黎元。

translations.literal: Consult you, Qi king: From utmost antiquity at the first ordering, the myriad transformations were tangled; opening brilliance and spirit to mirror the multitude of things, establishing the primordial lord to govern the black-haired folk.
translations.idiomatic: Consult you, Qi king: From utmost antiquity at the first ordering, the myriad transformations were tangled; opening brilliance and spirit to mirror the multitude of things, establishing the primordial lord to govern the black-haired folk.

sentences.zh: 若夫容成、大庭之世，伏羲、五龍之辰，靡得而詳焉。

translations.literal: As for the age of Rongcheng and Great Court, the time of Fuxi and Five Dragons — none can be detailed.
translations.idiomatic: As for the age of Rongcheng and Great Court, the time of Fuxi and Five Dragons — none can be detailed.

sentences.zh: 自軒黃以降，墳索所紀，略可言者，莫崇乎堯、舜。

translations.literal: From Xuanyuan and Huangdi downward, what the tomb records and cords record can be spoken of — none is greater than Yao and Shun.
translations.idiomatic: From Xuanyuan and Huangdi downward, what the tomb records and cords record can be spoken of — none is greater than Yao and Shun.

sentences.zh: 披金繩而握天鏡，開玉匣而總地維，德之休明，宸居靈極，期運有終，歸禪與能。

translations.literal: They spread the golden cord and grasped the heavenly mirror, opened the jade casket and gathered the earth's net; virtue was flourishing and bright, the imperial seat numinous and extreme; the term of fate had end — abdication returned to the able.
translations.idiomatic: They spread the golden cord and grasped the heavenly mirror, opened the jade casket and gathered the earth's net; virtue was flourishing and bright, the imperial seat numinous and extreme; the term of fate had end — abdication returned to the able.

sentences.zh: 所以大唐遜位，勞然興歌，有虞揖讓，卿雲發采，遺風餘烈，光被無垠。

translations.literal: Therefore Great Tang yielded the throne — laboriously songs arose; Youyu yielded — auspicious clouds issued color; the remaining wind and lingering blaze, light covered without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Great Tang yielded the throne — laboriously songs arose; Youyu yielded — auspicious clouds issued color; the remaining wind and lingering blaze, light covered without bound.

sentences.zh: 漢、魏因循，不敢失墜，爰逮有晉，亦遵前典。

translations.literal: Han and Wei followed in succession, not daring to lose and fall; down to Jin, they also followed the former canon.
translations.idiomatic: Han and Wei followed in succession, not daring to lose and fall; down to Jin, they also followed the former canon.

sentences.zh: 昔我祖宗英叡，旁格幽明，末葉不造，仍世多故。

translations.literal: Formerly our ancestors were heroic and keen, reaching to dark and bright; the final leaf was ill-formed and generations had many troubles.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly our ancestors were heroic and keen, reaching to dark and bright; the final leaf was ill-formed and generations had many troubles.

sentences.zh: 惟王聖哲欽明，榮鏡區宇，仁育群生，義征不譓，聲化遠洎，荒服無虞，殊類同規，華戎一族。

translations.literal: Only the king is sage and reverent, bright mirror of the realm; benevolence nourishes the multitude; righteousness campaigns against the unrepentant; fame and transformation reach far; wild clothes are without worry; different kinds same rule; Hua and Rong one clan.
translations.idiomatic: Only the king is sage and reverent, bright mirror of the realm; benevolence nourishes the multitude; righteousness campaigns against the unrepentant; fame and transformation reach far; wild clothes are without worry; different kinds same rule; Hua and Rong one clan.

sentences.zh: 是以五色來儀於軒庭，九穗含芳於郊牧。

translations.literal: Therefore the five colors came to court at the Xuanyuan hall; nine ears contained fragrance at the suburban pastures.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the five colors came to court at the Xuanyuan hall; nine ears contained fragrance at the suburban pastures.

sentences.zh: 象緯昭徹，布新之符已顯，圖讖彪煥，受終之義既彰，靈只乃眷，兆庶引領。

translations.literal: Constellations and weft were clear and penetrating; the token of spreading the new was already manifest; charts and prophecies were brilliant; the righteousness of receiving the end was already displayed; the numinous spirits then looked with favor; the myriad masses led their necks.
translations.idiomatic: Constellations and weft were clear and penetrating; the token of spreading the new was already manifest; charts and prophecies were brilliant; the righteousness of receiving the end was already displayed; the numinous spirits then looked with favor; the myriad masses led their necks.

sentences.zh: 朕聞至道深微，惟人是弘，天命無常，惟德是與。

translations.literal: I have heard the utmost Way is deep and subtle — only men are to be magnified; Heaven's mandate is without constancy — only virtue is to be given.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard the utmost Way is deep and subtle — only men are to be magnified; Heaven's mandate is without constancy — only virtue is to be given.

sentences.zh: 所以仰鑒玄情，俯察群議，敬禪神器，授帝位於爾躬。

translations.literal: Therefore looking up to mirror the dark sentiment, looking down to examine the crowd's deliberation — reverently yielding the divine vessel, conferring the imperial position on your person.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore looking up to mirror the dark sentiment, looking down to examine the crowd's deliberation — reverently yielding the divine vessel, conferring the imperial position on your person.

sentences.zh: 四海困窮，天祿永終。

translations.literal: The four seas are trapped and exhausted; Heaven's salary forever ends.
translations.idiomatic: The four seas are trapped and exhausted; Heaven's salary forever ends.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 王其允執厥中，儀刑前式，以副率土之欣望。

translations.literal: King, truly hold the center; model the former pattern; to match the joy and hope of all within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: King, truly hold the center; model the former pattern; to match the joy and hope of all within the realm.

sentences.zh: 命司裘而謁蒼昊，奏雲門而升圓丘，時膺大禮，永保洪業，豈不盛歟！

translations.literal: Command the Director of Fur to visit the dark Heaven, play the Cloud Gate and ascend the round mound — timely receive the grand rites, forever preserve the great enterprise — is it not flourishing!
translations.idiomatic: Command the Director of Fur to visit the dark Heaven, play the Cloud Gate and ascend the round mound — timely receive the grand rites, forever preserve the great enterprise — is it not flourishing!

sentences.zh: 並命璽書，遣兼太保、司空褚彥回，兼太尉、守尚書令王僧虔奉皇帝璽綬，受終之禮，一依唐、虞故事。

translations.literal: Also command the seal edict; dispatch concurrent Grand Tutor, Minister of Works Chu Yanhui, concurrent Grand Commandant, Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Sengqian to present the imperial seal and cord; the rites of receiving the end all follow the Tang and Yu story.
translations.idiomatic: Also command the seal edict; dispatch concurrent Grand Tutor, Minister of Works Chu Yanhui, concurrent Grand Commandant, Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Sengqian to present the imperial seal and cord; the rites of receiving the end all follow the Tang and Yu story.

sentences.zh: 高帝固讓，宋朝王公以下陳留王粲等，詣門陳請，帝猶未許。

translations.literal: Emperor Gao firmly declined; the Song dynasty's kings, dukes and below, Chen Liu of Chenliu and others, went to the gate and submitted requests — the emperor still did not assent.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gao firmly declined; the Song dynasty's kings, dukes and below, Chen Liu of Chenliu and others, went to the gate and submitted requests — the emperor still did not assent.

sentences.zh: 齊世子卿士以下固請；

translations.literal: The Qi heir apparent, ministers and scholars and below firmly requested;
translations.idiomatic: The Qi heir apparent, ministers and scholars and below firmly requested;

sentences.zh: 兼太史令、將作匠陳文建奏符瑞，因言漢自建武至建安二十五年，一百九十六年而禪魏；

translations.literal: concurrent Grand Astrologer, Director of Construction Chen Wenjian memorialized on tokens and omens, saying Han from Jianwu to Jian'an twenty-five years — one hundred ninety-six years and abdication to Wei;
translations.idiomatic: concurrent Grand Astrologer, Director of Construction Chen Wenjian memorialized on tokens and omens, saying Han from Jianwu to Jian'an twenty-five years — one hundred ninety-six years and abdication to Wei;

sentences.zh: 魏自黃初至咸熙二年，四十六年而禪晉；

translations.literal: Wei from Huangchu to Xianxi second year — forty-six years and abdication to Jin;
translations.idiomatic: Wei from Huangchu to Xianxi second year — forty-six years and abdication to Jin;

sentences.zh: 晉自泰始至元熙二年，一百五十六年而禪宋；

translations.literal: Jin from Taishi to Yuanxi second year — one hundred fifty-six years and abdication to Song;
translations.idiomatic: Jin from Taishi to Yuanxi second year — one hundred fifty-six years and abdication to Song;

sentences.zh: 宋自永初元年至升明三年，凡六十年；

translations.literal: Song from Yongchu first year to Shengming third year — altogether sixty years;
translations.idiomatic: Song from Yongchu first year to Shengming third year — altogether sixty years;

sentences.zh: 咸以六終六受，六，亢位也。

translations.literal: all with six ending and six receiving — six is the kang position.
translations.idiomatic: all with six ending and six receiving — six is the kang position.

sentences.zh: 驗往揆今，若斯昭著，敢以職任，備陳管穴，伏願順天時，膺符瑞。

translations.literal: Examining past and measuring present, if so clear and manifest — I dare by office prepare and state this narrow view; humbly wish to follow Heaven's time and receive the token and omen.
translations.idiomatic: Examining past and measuring present, if so clear and manifest — I dare by office prepare and state this narrow view; humbly wish to follow Heaven's time and receive the token and omen.

sentences.zh: 二朝百辟又固請。

translations.literal: The two courts' hundred ministers again firmly requested.
translations.idiomatic: The two courts' hundred ministers again firmly requested.

sentences.zh: 尚書右僕射王儉奏：「被宋詔遜位，臣等參議，宜克日受禪。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Jian memorialized: "Receiving the Song edict to yield the throne, we ministers jointly deliberated — it is fitting on an appointed day to receive abdication.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Jian memorialized: "Receiving the Song edict to yield the throne, we ministers jointly deliberated — it is fitting on an appointed day to receive abdication.

sentences.zh: 」高帝乃許焉。

translations.literal: " Emperor Gao then assented.
translations.idiomatic: " Emperor Gao then assented.

sentences.zh: 建元元年夏四月甲午，皇帝即位于南郊，柴燎告天曰：

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Jianyuan, on jiawu, the emperor ascended the throne at the southern suburb; burning firewood he reported to Heaven saying:
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Jianyuan, on jiawu, the emperor ascended the throne at the southern suburb; burning firewood he reported to Heaven saying:

sentences.zh: 皇帝臣道成，敢用玄牡，昭告於皇皇后帝：

translations.literal: Emperor your subject Daocheng, dares to use the dark stallion, clearly report to the August Supreme Emperor and August Empress:
translations.idiomatic: Emperor your subject Daocheng, dares to use the dark stallion, clearly report to the August Supreme Emperor and August Empress:

sentences.zh: 夫肇自生靈，樹以司牧，所以闡極立則，開元創物，肆茲大道。

translations.literal: From the beginning when living beings arose, they were planted with overseers — therefore to spread the extreme and establish the standard, open the origin and create things — extend this great Way.
translations.idiomatic: From the beginning when living beings arose, they were planted with overseers — therefore to spread the extreme and establish the standard, open the origin and create things — extend this great Way.

sentences.zh: 天下惟公，命不于常。

translations.literal: Under Heaven only the public; mandate is not from constancy.
translations.idiomatic: Under Heaven only the public; mandate is not from constancy.

sentences.zh: 昔在虞、夏，受終上代，粵自漢、魏，揖讓中葉，咸煥諸方策，載在典謨。

translations.literal: Formerly at Yu and Xia, receiving the end from the upper age; from Han and Wei, yielding in the middle leaf — all shone in the various regional plans, recorded in the canon and deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly at Yu and Xia, receiving the end from the upper age; from Han and Wei, yielding in the middle leaf — all shone in the various regional plans, recorded in the canon and deliberation.

sentences.zh: 水德既微，仍世多故，實賴道成匡救之功，以弘濟乎厥艱。

translations.literal: Water virtue was already faint; generations had many troubles; truly relying on Daocheng's rescue merit, thereby grandly crossing those difficulties.
translations.idiomatic: Water virtue was already faint; generations had many troubles; truly relying on Daocheng's rescue merit, thereby grandly crossing those difficulties.

sentences.zh: 大造顛墜，再構區宇，誕惟天人，罔弗和會。

translations.literal: Greatly making the overturned and fallen, again constructing the realm; truly only Heaven and man — none not harmonious and joined.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly making the overturned and fallen, again constructing the realm; truly only Heaven and man — none not harmonious and joined.

sentences.zh: 乃仰協歸運，景屬與能，用集大命於茲。

translations.literal: Then looking up to accord with the returning fortune, the scene belonged to the able; thereby gathering the great mandate here.
translations.idiomatic: Then looking up to accord with the returning fortune, the scene belonged to the able; thereby gathering the great mandate here.

sentences.zh: 辭德匪嗣，至於累仍，而群公卿士，庶尹禦事，爰及黎獻，暨乎百蠻，僉曰皇天眷命，不可以固違，人神無統，不可以曠主。

translations.literal: Declining virtue was not successor — reaching to repeated times; yet the various dukes, ministers and scholars, the multitude of officials managing affairs, reaching to the black-haired and offering, and to the hundred barbarians — all said August Heaven looks with favor on the mandate, it cannot be firmly violated; men and spirits have no ruler, it cannot be long without a lord.
translations.idiomatic: Declining virtue was not successor — reaching to repeated times; yet the various dukes, ministers and scholars, the multitude of officials managing affairs, reaching to the black-haired and offering, and to the hundred barbarians — all said August Heaven looks with favor on the mandate, it cannot be firmly violated; men and spirits have no ruler, it cannot be long without a lord.

sentences.zh: 畏天之威，敢不祗順鴻曆。

translations.literal: In awe of Heaven's majesty, I dare not but reverently follow the great succession.
translations.idiomatic: In awe of Heaven's majesty, I dare not but reverently follow the great succession.

sentences.zh: 敬簡元辰，虔奉皇符，升壇受禪，告類上帝，以答人衷，式敷萬國。

translations.literal: Reverently selecting the primary day, reverently holding the imperial token, ascending the altar receiving abdication, reporting to categorize the Supreme Emperor, to answer men's inner hearts, thereby spreading to the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently selecting the primary day, reverently holding the imperial token, ascending the altar receiving abdication, reporting to categorize the Supreme Emperor, to answer men's inner hearts, thereby spreading to the myriad states.

sentences.zh: 惟明靈是饗。

translations.literal: May the bright spirits partake.
translations.idiomatic: May the bright spirits partake.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，備大駕，幸建康宮，臨太極前殿。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, the full imperial carriage was prepared; he visited Jiankang Palace and faced the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were complete, the full imperial carriage was prepared; he visited Jiankang Palace and faced the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元。

translations.literal: Great pardon; changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: Great pardon; changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 賜人爵二級，文武位二等，鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，穀人五斛。

translations.literal: Granted men two ranks of nobility, civil and military two ranks of office; widows, orphans and solitary who could not support themselves — five hu of grain per person.
translations.idiomatic: Granted men two ranks of nobility, civil and military two ranks of office; widows, orphans and solitary who could not support themselves — five hu of grain per person.

sentences.zh: 逋租宿責勿收。

translations.literal: Overdue rent and old debts were not collected.
translations.idiomatic: Overdue rent and old debts were not collected.

sentences.zh: 犯鄉論清議、贓汙淫盜者，一皆蕩滌，洗除先注，與之更始。

translations.literal: Those who violated village pure criticism, corruption, lewdness and theft — all were washed clean; prior records removed; given a fresh start.
translations.idiomatic: Those who violated village pure criticism, corruption, lewdness and theft — all were washed clean; prior records removed; given a fresh start.

sentences.zh: 長徒敕系者，特加原遣。

translations.literal: Those on long-term exile and imprisonment — specially additionally pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: Those on long-term exile and imprisonment — specially additionally pardoned and released.

sentences.zh: 亡官失爵，禁錮奪勞，一依舊典。

translations.literal: Lost office and lost rank, forbidden and stripped of labor — all according to the old canon.
translations.idiomatic: Lost office and lost rank, forbidden and stripped of labor — all according to the old canon.

sentences.zh: 封宋帝為汝陰王，築宮於丹陽故縣，行宋正朔，車旗服色，一如晉、宋故事，上書不為表，答表不稱詔。

translations.literal: The Song emperor was enfeoffed as Prince of Runan; a palace was built at the old district of Danyang; he followed Song's calendar; carriage banners and dress colors all as the Jin and Song story; memorials upward were not called tables; replies to tables did not call edicts.
translations.idiomatic: The Song emperor was enfeoffed as Prince of Runan; a palace was built at the old district of Danyang; he followed Song's calendar; carriage banners and dress colors all as the Jin and Song story; memorials upward were not called tables; replies to tables did not call edicts.

sentences.zh: 宋諸王皆降為公，郡公主為縣君，縣公主為鄉君。

translations.literal: All Song princes were reduced to dukes; commandery princesses to county ladies; county princesses to village ladies.
translations.idiomatic: All Song princes were reduced to dukes; commandery princesses to county ladies; county princesses to village ladies.

sentences.zh: 詔降宋南康郡公為縣公，華容公為侯，萍鄉侯為伯，減戶有差，以奉劉穆之、王弘、何無忌之祀。

translations.literal: An edict reduced Duke of Nankang Commandery of Song to county duke, Duke of Huarong to marquis, Marquis of Pingxiang to earl — households reduced with difference — to maintain the sacrifices of Liu Muzhi, Wang Hong, and He Wuji.
translations.idiomatic: An edict reduced Duke of Nankang Commandery of Song to county duke, Duke of Huarong to marquis, Marquis of Pingxiang to earl — households reduced with difference — to maintain the sacrifices of Liu Muzhi, Wang Hong, and He Wuji.

sentences.zh: 追尊皇考曰宣皇帝，皇妣曰孝皇后，陵曰永安。

translations.literal: Posthumously honored the emperor's father as Emperor Xuan; the emperor's mother as Empress Xiao; tomb called Yong'an.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously honored the emperor's father as Emperor Xuan; the emperor's mother as Empress Xiao; tomb called Yong'an.

sentences.zh: 妃曰昭皇后，陵曰泰安。

translations.literal: Consort as Empress Zhao; tomb called Tai'an.
translations.idiomatic: Consort as Empress Zhao; tomb called Tai'an.

sentences.zh: 詔劫賊餘口沒在台府者，悉原赦。

translations.literal: An edict: remaining mouths of bandit captives confiscated in the palace workshops — all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: An edict: remaining mouths of bandit captives confiscated in the palace workshops — all pardoned.

sentences.zh: 諸負釁流徙者，皆聽還本土。

translations.literal: All bearing guilt in exile — all were permitted to return to their native places.
translations.idiomatic: All bearing guilt in exile — all were permitted to return to their native places.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以荊州刺史嶷為尚書令、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On wuxu Yi was made Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon of the First Order.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Yi was made Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon of the First Order.

sentences.zh: 斷四方上慶禮。

translations.literal: Cut off congratulatory rites from the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Cut off congratulatory rites from the four directions.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔二宮諸王，悉不得營立屯邸，封略山湖。

translations.literal: On jihai an edict: the two palaces' various princes — all must not establish garrison lodges or seize mountain lakes.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai an edict: the two palaces' various princes — all must not establish garrison lodges or seize mountain lakes.

sentences.zh: 乃停太官池禦稅。

translations.literal: Then stopped the Grand Provisioner's pond imperial tax.
translations.idiomatic: Then stopped the Grand Provisioner's pond imperial tax.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔宋帝后藩王諸陵，量置守衛。

translations.literal: On gengzi an edict: the Song emperor's consorts, feudal princes and various tombs — guards were set according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict: the Song emperor's consorts, feudal princes and various tombs — guards were set according to measure.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，以河南王吐谷渾拾寅為驃騎大將軍。

translations.literal: On the fifth month, on bingwu, Prince of Henan Tuyuhun Shiyin was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the fifth month, Prince of Henan Tuyuhun Shiyin was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 詔宋氏第秩，量所廢置。

translations.literal: An edict on Song clan ranks and stipends — measured what was abolished and established.
translations.idiomatic: An edict on Song clan ranks and stipends — measured what was abolished and established.

sentences.zh: 有司奏留襄陽郡公張敬兒等六十二人，除廣興郡公沈曇亮等一百二十二人。

translations.literal: The relevant office memorialized retaining Duke of Xiangyang Commandery Zhang Jing'er and others sixty-two men; removing Duke of Guangxing Commandery Shen Tanliang and others one hundred twenty-two men.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant office memorialized retaining Duke of Xiangyang Commandery Zhang Jing'er and others sixty-two men; removing Duke of Guangxing Commandery Shen Tanliang and others one hundred twenty-two men.

sentences.zh: 改元嘉曆為建元曆，祖以正月卯，臘以十二月未。

translations.literal: Changed the Yuanjia calendar to the Jianyuan calendar; ancestor month on first month mao, winter sacrifice on twelfth month wei.
translations.idiomatic: Changed the Yuanjia calendar to the Jianyuan calendar; ancestor month on first month mao, winter sacrifice on twelfth month wei.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔曰：「設募取將，縣賞購士，蓋出權宜，自今可斷眾募。

translations.literal: On dingwei an edict said: "Setting recruitment to obtain generals, county bounty to purchase warriors — this is entirely expedient; from now recruitment of the masses may be cut off.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei an edict said: "Setting recruitment to obtain generals, county bounty to purchase warriors — this is entirely expedient; from now recruitment of the masses may be cut off.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，河南國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: " On yimao the Kingdom of Henan sent envoys paying tribute.
translations.idiomatic: " On yimao the Kingdom of Henan sent envoys paying tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔遣兼散騎常侍十二人，巡行四方。

translations.literal: On bingchen an edict dispatched twelve concurrent Attendants Cavalier at Regular Attendance to tour the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict dispatched twelve concurrent Attendants Cavalier at Regular Attendance to tour the four directions.

sentences.zh: 己未，汝陰王殂，齊志也，追諡為宋順帝。

translations.literal: On jiwei the Prince of Runan died — Qi will records it; posthumously titled Emperor Shun of Song.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the Prince of Runan died — Qi will records it; posthumously titled Emperor Shun of Song.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，誅陰安公劉燮等。

translations.literal: On xinyou Duke of Yin'an Liu Xie and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Duke of Yin'an Liu Xie and others were executed.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，詔宋末以來，枯骸毀櫬，宣下埋藏。

translations.literal: On the sixth month, on yihai, an edict: from Song's end onward, dried bones and destroyed coffins — proclaim burial.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the sixth month, an edict: from Song's end onward, dried bones and destroyed coffins — proclaim burial.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，備法駕，奉七廟主於太廟。

translations.literal: On gengchen the full imperial carriage was prepared; the seven temple lords were conveyed to the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the full imperial carriage was prepared; the seven temple lords were conveyed to the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲申，立齊太子賾為皇太子。

translations.literal: On jiashen the Qi crown prince Ze was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Qi crown prince Ze was established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 斷諸州郡禮慶，降死罪以下刑，並申前赦恩百日。

translations.literal: Cut off congratulatory rites of the various provinces and commanderies; reduced death penalty and below; also extended the prior pardon grace one hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: Cut off congratulatory rites of the various provinces and commanderies; reduced death penalty and below; also extended the prior pardon grace one hundred days.

sentences.zh: 立皇子嶷為豫章王，映為臨川王，晃為長沙王，曄為武陵王，暠為安成王，鏘為鄱陽王，鑠為桂陽王，鑒為廣興王，皇孫長懋為南郡王。

translations.literal: Established princes Yi as Prince of Yuzhang, Ying as Prince of Linchuan, Huang as Prince of Changsha, Ye as Prince of Wuling, Gao as Prince of Ancheng, Qiang as Prince of Poyang, Shuo as Prince of Guiyang, Jian as Prince of Guangxing; imperial grandson Changmao as Prince of Nan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Established princes Yi as Prince of Yuzhang, Ying as Prince of Linchuan, Huang as Prince of Changsha, Ye as Prince of Wuling, Gao as Prince of Ancheng, Qiang as Prince of Poyang, Shuo as Prince of Guiyang, Jian as Prince of Guangxing; imperial grandson Changmao as Prince of Nan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，葬宋順帝于遂寧陵。

translations.literal: On yiyou Emperor Shun of Song was buried at Suining Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Emperor Shun of Song was buried at Suining Tomb.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，曲赦交州部內。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingwei, partial pardon within Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingwei, partial pardon within Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔南蘭陵桑梓本鄉，長蠲租布；

translations.literal: On dingsi an edict: South Lanling, native district of mulberry and ancestral home, long exemption from rent and cloth;
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi an edict: South Lanling, native district of mulberry and ancestral home, long exemption from rent and cloth;

sentences.zh: 武進王業所基，給復十年。

translations.literal: Wujin, foundation of the king's enterprise, granted exemption ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Wujin, foundation of the king's enterprise, granted exemption ten years.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，省陳留國。

translations.literal: On the eighth month, on guisi, Chenliu State was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the eighth month, Chenliu State was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，立皇子鈞為衡陽王。

translations.literal: On dingsi Prince Jun was established as Prince of Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Prince Jun was established as Prince of Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，詔以二吳、義興三郡遭水，減今年田租。

translations.literal: On the ninth month, on xinchou, an edict: because the two Wu and Yixing three commanderies suffered flood, reduced this year's field rent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the ninth month, an edict: because the two Wu and Yixing three commanderies suffered flood, reduced this year's field rent.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復置南蠻校尉官。

translations.literal: On yisi the office of Commandant of Southern Barbarians was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the office of Commandant of Southern Barbarians was restored.

sentences.zh: 丙午，加司空褚彥回尚書令。

translations.literal: On bingwu Minister of Works Chu Yanhui was promoted to Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Minister of Works Chu Yanhui was promoted to Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月戊戌朔，大赦。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the second year, on wuxu new year's day, great pardon.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month of the second year, on wuxu new year's day, great pardon.

sentences.zh: 以司空褚彥回為司徒，以尚書右僕射王儉為左僕射。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Chu Yanhui was made Minister of Works; Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Jian was made Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Chu Yanhui was made Minister of Works; Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Jian was made Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On xinchou he sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，魏軍攻壽陽，豫州刺史垣崇祖破走之。

translations.literal: On the second month, on dingmao, Wei armies attacked Shouyang; Inspector of Yu Province Yuan Chongzu defeated and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the second month, Wei armies attacked Shouyang; Yuan Chongzu, Inspector of Yu Province, defeated and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，遣大使巡慰淮、肥、徐、豫邊人尤貧遘難者。

translations.literal: On guisi he dispatched grand envoys to tour and comfort the border people of Huai, Fei, Xu, and Yu who were especially poor and met with hardship.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he dispatched grand envoys to tour and comfort the border people of Huai, Fei, Xu, and Yu who were especially poor and met with hardship.

sentences.zh: 三月，百濟國遣使朝貢，以其王牟都為鎮東大將軍。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Kingdom of Baekje sent envoys paying tribute; its king Moudu was made General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Kingdom of Baekje sent envoys paying tribute; its king Moudu was made General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，進高麗王樂浪公高璉號驃騎大將軍。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingyin, King of Goguryeo Duke of Lelang Gao Lian's title was advanced to Grand General of Agile Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on bingyin, Gao Lian, King of Goguryeo Duke of Lelang, had his title advanced to Grand General of Agile Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 五月，立六門都牆。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Six Gates Capital Wall was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Six Gates Capital Wall was established.

sentences.zh: 秋九月甲午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, on jiawu new year's day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the ninth month, on jiawu new year's day, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 丙子，蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Rouran kingdom sent envoys paying tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Rouran kingdom sent envoys paying tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月戊戌，以司空褚彥回為司徒。

translations.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, on wuxu, Minister of Works Chu Yanhui was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the twelfth month, on wuxu, Minister of Works Chu Yanhui was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以驃騎豫章王嶷為司空。

translations.literal: On renzi Grand General of Agile Cavalry Prince of Yuzhang Yi was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Grand General of Agile Cavalry Prince of Yuzhang Yi was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月壬戌朔，詔王公卿士薦讜言。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the third year, on renxu new year's day, an edict: kings, dukes, ministers and scholars recommend straight words.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month of the third year, on renxu new year's day, an edict: kings, dukes, ministers and scholars recommend straight words.

sentences.zh: 丙子，立皇子鋒為江夏王。

translations.literal: On bingzi Prince Feng was established as Prince of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Prince Feng was established as Prince of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，罷南蠻校尉官。

translations.literal: On the second month, on guichou, the office of Commandant of Southern Barbarians was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the second month, the office of Commandant of Southern Barbarians was abolished.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，始制東宮臣僚用下官禮敬聞喜公子良等。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on xinhai, for the first time Eastern Palace ministers and officials used lower-official ritual respect toward Wenxi Duke Ziliang and others.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on xinhai, for the first time Eastern Palace ministers and officials used lower-official ritual respect toward Wenxi Duke Ziliang and others.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，大赦。

translations.literal: On the sixth month, on renzi, great pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the sixth month, great pardon.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiwei new year's day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiwei new year's day, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，蠕蠕國王遣使欲俱攻魏，獻師子皮褲褶。

translations.literal: On the ninth month, on xinwei, the king of Rouran sent envoys wishing jointly to attack Wei, presenting lion-skin trousers and jacket.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the ninth month, the king of Rouran sent envoys wishing jointly to attack Wei, presenting lion-skin trousers and jacket.

sentences.zh: 烏程令吳郡顧昌玄，坐父法秀宋泰始中北征死亡，屍骸不反，而昌玄宴樂嬉游，與常人無異。

translations.literal: Magistrate of Wucheng Gu Changxuan of Wu Commandery, because his father Faxiu died on the northern campaign in Taishi of Song and his corpse did not return, yet Changxuan feasted and amused himself in play — no different from ordinary men.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Changxuan, Magistrate of Wucheng in Wu Commandery, because his father Faxiu died on the northern campaign in Taishi of Song and his corpse did not return, yet Changxuan feasted and amused himself in play — no different from ordinary men.

sentences.zh: 有司請加以清議。

translations.literal: The relevant office requested adding pure criticism.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant office requested adding pure criticism.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，置會稽山陰縣獄丞。

translations.literal: On bingxu the prison assistant of Shanyin County, Kuaiji, was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the prison assistant of Shanyin County, Kuaiji, was established.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，以河南王世子吐谷渾度易侯為西秦河二州刺史、河南王。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wuzi, the heir of the Kingdom of Henan Tuyuhun Duyihou was made Inspector of West Qin and He Provinces, Prince of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on wuzi, the heir of the Kingdom of Henan Tuyuhun Duyihou was made Inspector of West Qin and He Provinces, Prince of Henan.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the twelfth month, on dinghai, the Kingdom of Goguryeo sent envoys paying tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the twelfth month, the Kingdom of Goguryeo sent envoys paying tribute.

sentences.zh: 命散騎常侍虞炎等十二人巡行諸州郡，觀省風俗。

translations.literal: He ordered Attendant Cavalier at Regular Attendance Yu Yan and twelve others to tour the various provinces and commanderies, observing and examining customs.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Yu Yan, Attendant Cavalier at Regular Attendance, and twelve others to tour the various provinces and commanderies, observing and examining customs.

sentences.zh: 四年春二月乙未，上不豫。

translations.literal: In spring, the second month of the fourth year, on yiwei, the emperor was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the second month of the fourth year, on yiwei, the emperor was unwell.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔原都下囚系有差，免元年以前逋責。

translations.literal: On gengxu an edict pardoned capital prisoners with difference; remitted overdue debts before the first year.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu an edict pardoned capital prisoners with difference; remitted overdue debts before the first year.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，召司徒褚彥回、左僕射王儉受顧托。

translations.literal: On the third month, on gengshen, he summoned Minister of Works Chu Yanhui and Left Vice Director Wang Jian to receive the deathbed charge.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the third month, he summoned Chu Yanhui, Minister of Works, and Wang Jian, Left Vice Director, to receive the deathbed charge.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，皇帝崩于臨光殿，年五十六。

translations.literal: On renxu the emperor died at the Hall of Facing Light, age fifty-six.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the emperor died at the Hall of Facing Light, age fifty-six.

sentences.zh: 群臣上諡曰高皇帝，廟號太祖。

translations.literal: The ministers submitted posthumous title Emperor Gao; temple name Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers submitted posthumous title Emperor Gao; temple name Taizu.

sentences.zh: 梓宮於東府前渚升龍舟。

translations.literal: The imperial coffin from the foreshore before the Eastern Palace ascended the dragon boat.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial coffin from the foreshore before the Eastern Palace ascended the dragon boat.

sentences.zh: 四月丙午，葬于武進泰安陵，於龍舟卒哭，內外反吉。

translations.literal: On the fourth month, on bingwu, he was buried at Tai'an Tomb in Wujin; on the dragon boat the final wailing ended; within and without returned to auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the fourth month, he was buried at Tai'an Tomb in Wujin; on the dragon boat the final wailing ended; within and without returned to auspicious.

sentences.zh: 上少有大量，喜怒不形於色，深沈靜默，常有四海之心。

translations.literal: The emperor from youth had great capacity; joy and anger did not show in his countenance; deeply silent and still; he constantly had the mind of the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor from youth had great capacity; joy and anger did not show in his countenance; deeply silent and still; he constantly harbored the mind to embrace the four seas.

sentences.zh: 博學，善屬文，工草隸書，弈棋第二品。

translations.literal: Broadly learned, skilled at literary composition, accomplished at draft and clerical script, chess second rank.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly learned, skilled at literary composition, accomplished at draft and clerical script, chess second rank.

sentences.zh: 雖經綸夷險，不廢素業。

translations.literal: Though planning and governing through barbarian danger, he did not abandon his plain pursuits.
translations.idiomatic: Though planning and governing through barbarian danger, he did not abandon his plain pursuits.

sentences.zh: 及即位後，身不禦精細之物，主衣中有玉介導，以長侈奢之源，命打破之。

translations.literal: After ascending the throne, he personally did not use fine and delicate objects; among the chief garments was a jade girdle pendant — to cut off the source of long extravagance he ordered it broken.
translations.idiomatic: After ascending the throne, he personally did not use fine and delicate objects; among the chief garments was a jade girdle pendant — to cut off the source of long extravagance he ordered it broken.

sentences.zh: 凡異物皆令隨例毀棄。

translations.literal: All strange objects he ordered destroyed according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: All strange objects he ordered destroyed according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 後宮器物欄檻，以銅為飾者，皆改用鐵。

translations.literal: Inner palace vessels' railings and barriers — those decorated with copper — all were changed to use iron.
translations.idiomatic: Inner palace vessels' railings and barriers — those decorated with copper — all were changed to use iron.

sentences.zh: 內殿施黃紗帳，宮人著紫皮履。

translations.literal: The inner hall used yellow gauze curtains; palace women wore purple leather shoes.
translations.idiomatic: The inner hall used yellow gauze curtains; palace women wore purple leather shoes.

sentences.zh: 華蓋除金華爪，用鐵回釘。

translations.literal: The ceremonial canopy removed golden flower claws; used iron loop nails.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial canopy removed golden flower claws; used iron loop nails.

sentences.zh: 每曰：「使我臨天下十年，當使黃金與土同價。

translations.literal: He often said: "If you let me face the realm ten years, I shall make gold and soil the same price.
translations.idiomatic: He often said, "If you let me face the realm ten years, I shall make gold and soil the same price.

sentences.zh: 」欲以身率下，移風易俗。

translations.literal: " He wished by his person to lead those below and shift customs.
translations.idiomatic: " He wished by his person to lead those below and shift customs.

sentences.zh: 性寬，嘗與直合將軍周覆、給事中褚思莊共棋，累局不倦，覆乃抑上手，不許易行。

translations.literal: His nature was generous; once with Direct Palace Gate General Zhou Fu and Palace Attendant Chu Sizhuang he played chess — many games without weariness; Fu then pressed the emperor's hand, not permitting changing moves.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was generous; once with Zhou Fu, Direct Palace Gate General, and Chu Sizhuang, Palace Attendant, he played chess — many games without weariness; Fu then pressed the emperor's hand, not permitting changing moves.

sentences.zh: 其弘厚如此。

translations.literal: His magnanimity was thus.
translations.idiomatic: His magnanimity was thus.

sentences.zh: 所著文，詔中書侍郎江淹撰次之。

translations.literal: Literary works he composed — he ordered Palace Secretariat Gentleman Jiang Yan to compile and arrange them.
translations.idiomatic: Literary works he composed — he ordered Jiang Yan, Palace Secretariat Gentleman, to compile and arrange them.

sentences.zh: 又詔東觀學士撰史林三十篇，魏文帝皇覽之流也。

translations.literal: Also he edicted Eastern Hall scholars to compile History Grove thirty chapters — in the stream of Wei Emperor Wen's Imperial Overview.
translations.idiomatic: Also he edicted Eastern Hall scholars to compile History Grove thirty chapters — in the stream of Wei Emperor Wen's Imperial Overview.

sentences.zh: 始帝年十七時，嘗夢乘青龍上天，西行逐日。

translations.literal: At the beginning when the emperor was seventeen, he once dreamed of riding a green dragon to Heaven, going west pursuing the sun.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning when the emperor was seventeen, he once dreamed of riding a green dragon to Heaven, going west pursuing the sun.

sentences.zh: 帝舊塋在武進彭山，岡阜相屬，數百里不絕，其上常有五色雲，又有龍出焉。

translations.literal: The emperor's old tomb mound was at Mount Peng in Wujin; hills and mounds connected — several hundred li without break; above them were constantly five-colored clouds, and dragons also emerged.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's old tomb mound was at Mount Peng in Wujin; hills and mounds connected — several hundred li without break; above them were constantly five-colored clouds, and dragons also emerged.

sentences.zh: 上時已貴矣，宋明帝甚惡之，遣善占墓者高靈文往墓所占相。

translations.literal: At that time he was already honored; Emperor Ming of Song greatly hated this and sent a skilled tomb-diviner Gao Lingwen to go to the tomb mound to observe and examine.
translations.idiomatic: At that time he was already honored; Emperor Ming of Song greatly hated this and sent Gao Lingwen, a skilled tomb-diviner, to go to the tomb mound to observe and examine.

sentences.zh: 靈文先給事太祖，還，詭答曰：「不過出方伯耳。

translations.literal: Lingwen had formerly served the Taizu; returning, he deceptively answered: "Nothing more than producing a regional lord.
translations.idiomatic: Lingwen had formerly served the Taizu; returning, he deceptively answered, "Nothing more than producing a regional lord.

sentences.zh: 」密白太祖曰：「貴不可言。

translations.literal: " Secretly he reported to the Taizu: "Honor cannot be spoken.
translations.idiomatic: " Secretly he reported to the Taizu, "Honor cannot be spoken.

sentences.zh: 」明帝意猶不已，遣人踐藉，以左道厭之。

translations.literal: " Emperor Ming's intent still did not stop; he sent men to trample, using left-path arts to suppress it.
translations.idiomatic: " Emperor Ming's intent still did not stop; he sent men to trample, using left-path arts to suppress it.

sentences.zh: 上後於所樹華表柱忽龍鳴，震響山谷。

translations.literal: Later at the erected ceremonial canopy pillar the emperor suddenly dragon-cried; the sound shook the mountain valley.
translations.idiomatic: Later at the erected ceremonial canopy pillar the emperor suddenly dragon-cried; the sound shook the mountain valley.

sentences.zh: 明帝寢疾，為身後之慮，多翦功臣，上亦見疑，每云：「蕭道成有不臣相。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming lay ill; for concern after his death he repeatedly cut down meritorious ministers; the emperor was also suspected; he often said: "Xiao Daocheng has the countenance of disloyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming lay ill; for concern after his death he repeatedly cut down meritorious ministers; the emperor was also suspected; he often said, "Xiao Daocheng has the countenance of disloyalty.

sentences.zh: 」時鎮淮陰，每懷憂懼，忽見神人謂上曰：「無所憂，子孫當昌盛。

translations.literal: " At that time garrisoning Huaiyin, he constantly harbored worry and fear; suddenly he saw a spirit man tell the emperor: "Have no worry — descendants will flourish.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time garrisoning Huaiyin, he constantly harbored worry and fear; suddenly he saw a spirit man tell the emperor, "Have no worry — descendants will flourish.

sentences.zh: 」泰始三年，宋明帝遣前淮南太守孫奉伯往淮陰監元會。

translations.literal: " In the third year of Taishi, Emperor Ming of Song sent former Governor of Huainan Sun Fengbo to go to Huaiyin to supervise the New Year's assembly.
translations.idiomatic: " In the third year of Taishi, Emperor Ming of Song sent Sun Fengbo, former Governor of Huainan, to go to Huaiyin to supervise the New Year's assembly.

sentences.zh: 奉伯舊與帝款，是行也，帝與奉伯同室臥，奉伯夢上乘龍上天，于下捉龍腳，不得。

translations.literal: Fengbo formerly was on good terms with the emperor; on this journey the emperor and Fengbo shared a room to sleep; Fengbo dreamed of riding up to Heaven, below grasping the dragon's foot — could not obtain it.
translations.idiomatic: Fengbo formerly was on good terms with the emperor; on this journey the emperor and Fengbo shared a room to sleep; Fengbo dreamed of riding up to Heaven, below grasping the dragon's foot — could not obtain it.

sentences.zh: 及覺，敘夢，因謂曰：「兗州當大庇生靈，而弟不得與也。

translations.literal: When awake he narrated the dream and therefore said: "Yan Province will greatly shelter the living — yet younger brother cannot share in it.
translations.idiomatic: When awake he narrated the dream and therefore said, "Yan Province will greatly shelter the living — yet younger brother cannot share in it.

sentences.zh: 」奉伯竟卒于宋世。

translations.literal: " Fengbo in the end died in the Song age.
translations.idiomatic: " Fengbo in the end died in the Song age.

sentences.zh: 又參軍崔靈建夢天謂己：「蕭道成是我第十九子，我去年已使授其天子位。

translations.literal: Also Army Controller Cui Lingjian dreamed Heaven told him: "Xiao Daocheng is my nineteenth son; last year I already sent to confer on him the Son of Heaven's position.
translations.idiomatic: Also Army Controller Cui Lingjian dreamed Heaven told him, "Xiao Daocheng is my nineteenth son; last year I already sent to confer on him the Son of Heaven's position.

sentences.zh: 」考自三皇、五帝以降，受命之次，至帝為十九也。

translations.literal: " Examining from the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors downward, the order of receiving mandate — reaching the emperor was nineteenth.
translations.idiomatic: " Examining from the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors downward, the order of receiving mandate — reaching the emperor was nineteenth.

sentences.zh: 及為領軍，望氣者陳安寶見上身上恒有紫黃氣。

translations.literal: When he was Commander of the Palace Guard, the qi-watcher Chen Anbao saw on the emperor's body constantly purple-yellow qi.
translations.idiomatic: When he was Commander of the Palace Guard, the qi-watcher Chen Anbao saw on the emperor's body constantly purple-yellow qi.

sentences.zh: 安寶謂王洪範曰：「此人貴不可言。

translations.literal: Anbao told Wang Hongfan: "This man's honor cannot be spoken.
translations.idiomatic: Anbao told Wang Hongfan, "This man's honor cannot be spoken.

sentences.zh: 」所居武進縣有一道，相傳云：「天子路」。

translations.literal: " Where he resided in Wujin County there was a road; tradition transmitted: "Son of Heaven Road.
translations.idiomatic: " Where he resided in Wujin County there was a road; tradition transmitted, "Son of Heaven Road.

sentences.zh: 或謂秦皇所遊，或云孫氏舊跡。

translations.literal: " Some said Qin Shihuang traveled it; some said Sun clan old traces.
translations.idiomatic: " Some said Qin Shihuang traveled it; some said Sun clan old traces.

sentences.zh: 時訛言東城天子出。

translations.literal: At that time false rumor: Son of Heaven emerges from eastern city.
translations.idiomatic: At that time false rumor: Son of Heaven emerges from eastern city.

sentences.zh: 其後建安王休仁鎮東府，宋明帝懼，殺休仁，而常閉東府不居。

translations.literal: Afterward Prince Jian'an Xiuren garrisoned the Eastern Palace; Emperor Ming of Song feared and killed Xiuren; and constantly closed the Eastern Palace, not residing.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Prince Jian'an Xiuren garrisoned the Eastern Palace; Emperor Ming of Song feared and killed Xiuren; and constantly closed the Eastern Palace, not residing.

sentences.zh: 明帝又屢幸，改「代」作「伐」，以厭王氣。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming also repeatedly visited; changed "substitute" to "attack" — to suppress royal qi.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming also repeatedly visited; changed "substitute" to "attack" — to suppress royal qi.

sentences.zh: 又使子安成王代之。

translations.literal: Also he sent his son Prince of Ancheng to substitute.
translations.idiomatic: Also he sent his son Prince of Ancheng to substitute.

sentences.zh: 及蒼梧王敗，安成王代立，時咸言為驗。

translations.literal: When Deposed Emperor Cangwu was defeated, Prince of Ancheng substituted and established — at the time all said it was verified.
translations.idiomatic: When Deposed Emperor Cangwu was defeated, Prince of Ancheng substituted and established — at the time all said it was verified.

sentences.zh: 術數者推之，上舊居武進東城村，「東城「之言，其在此也。

translations.literal: Numbers masters pushed it — the emperor's old residence Wujin eastern city village — the words "eastern city" — it was here.
translations.idiomatic: Numbers masters pushed it — the emperor's old residence Wujin eastern city village — the words "eastern city" — it was here.

sentences.zh: 升明二年冬，延陵縣季子廟沸井之北，忽聞金石聲，疑其異，鑿深三尺，得沸井，奔湧若浪。

translations.literal: In winter of the second year of Shengming, north of the boiling well at Prince Ji Temple in Yanling County, suddenly heard metal and stone sound; suspecting its strangeness, they dug three chi deep and obtained a boiling well, surging like waves.
translations.idiomatic: In winter of the second year of Shengming, north of the boiling well at Prince Ji Temple in Yanling County, suddenly heard metal and stone sound; suspecting its strangeness, they dug three chi deep and obtained a boiling well, surging like waves.

sentences.zh: 其地又響，即復鑿之，復得一井，湧沸亦然。

translations.literal: That ground again sounded; then again dug; again obtained a well — surging and boiling likewise.
translations.idiomatic: That ground again sounded; then again dug; again obtained a well — surging and boiling likewise.

sentences.zh: 井中得一木簡，長一尺，廣二分，上有隱起字，曰：「廬山道人張陵再拜，詣闕起居。

translations.literal: In the well they obtained a wooden slip one chi long, two fen wide; on it raised hidden characters saying: "Mount Lu Daoist Zhang Ling again bows, goes to the gate to report health.
translations.idiomatic: In the well they obtained a wooden slip one chi long, two fen wide; on it raised hidden characters saying, "Mount Lu Daoist Zhang Ling again bows, goes to the gate to report health.

sentences.zh: 」簡木堅白，字色乃黃。

translations.literal: " The slip wood was firm and white; the character color was yellow.
translations.idiomatic: " The slip wood was firm and white; the character color was yellow.

sentences.zh: 瑞應圖云：「浪井不鑿自成，王者清靜，則仙人主之」。

translations.literal: Auspicious Response Diagram says: "Boiling well not dug self-forms — when the king is pure and quiet, then immortals master it."
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious Response Diagram says: "Boiling well not dug self-forms — when the king is pure and quiet, then immortals master it."

sentences.zh: 會稽剡縣有山，名刻石。

translations.literal: In Kuaiji, Yan County there was a mountain named Carved Stone.
translations.idiomatic: In Kuaiji, Yan County there was a mountain named Carved Stone.

sentences.zh: 父老相傳云，「山雖名刻石，而不知文字所在」。

translations.literal: Elders mutually transmitted: "Though the mountain is named Carved Stone, they did not know where the characters were."
translations.idiomatic: Elders mutually transmitted: "Though the mountain is named Carved Stone, they did not know where the characters were."

sentences.zh: 升明末，縣人兒襲祖行獵，忽見石上有文字，凡處，苔生其上，字不可識，乃去苔視之，其大石文曰：「此齊者，黃石公之化氣也。

translations.literal: At the end of Shengming, county man Er Zizu went hunting; suddenly saw characters on stone; wherever they were, moss grew above — characters could not be recognized; then removed moss to look — the great stone's text said: "This Qi is Yellow Stone Duke's transforming qi.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Shengming, county man Er Zizu went hunting; suddenly saw characters on stone; wherever they were, moss grew above — characters could not be recognized; then removed moss to look — the great stone's text said, "This Qi is Yellow Stone Duke's transforming qi.

sentences.zh: 」立石文曰：「黃天星，姓蕭，字道成，得賢帥，天下太平。

translations.literal: " Standing stone's text said: "Yellow Heaven Star, surname Xiao, character Daocheng, obtains worthy commander — under Heaven great peace.
translations.idiomatic: " Standing stone's text said, "Yellow Heaven Star, surname Xiao, character Daocheng, obtains worthy commander — under Heaven great peace.

sentences.zh: 」小石文曰：「刻石者誰？

translations.literal: " Small stone's text said: "Who carved stone?
translations.idiomatic: " Small stone's text said, "Who carved stone?

sentences.zh: 會稽南山李斯刻秦望之封也。

translations.literal: Kuaiji southern mountain Li Si carved Qin Wang's feng.
translations.idiomatic: Kuaiji southern mountain Li Si carved Qin Wang's feng.

sentences.zh: 」孝經鉤命決曰：「誰者起，視名將。

translations.literal: " Classic of Filial Piety Hooked Mandate Decision says: "Who rises — look at the name general.
translations.idiomatic: " Classic of Filial Piety Hooked Mandate Decision says, "Who rises — look at the name general.

sentences.zh: 」將，帝小字也。

translations.literal: " General — the emperor's childhood name.
translations.idiomatic: " General — the emperor's childhood name.

sentences.zh: 河洛讖曰：「歷年七十水滅緒，風雲俱起龍鱗舉。

translations.literal: River-Luo prophecy says: "Years reach seventy — water extinguishes thread; wind and clouds together rise, dragon scales lift.
translations.idiomatic: River-Luo prophecy says, "Years reach seventy — water extinguishes thread; wind and clouds together rise, dragon scales lift.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「肅肅草成，道德盡備。

translations.literal: " Also says: "Su-su grass forms — the Way's virtue all complete.
translations.idiomatic: " Also says, "Su-su grass forms — the Way's virtue all complete.

sentences.zh: 」案宋水德也。

translations.literal: " Case: Song was Water virtue.
translations.idiomatic: " Case: Song was Water virtue.

sentences.zh: 義熙元年，宋武帝王業之始，至齊受命，七十年。

translations.literal: First year of Yixi, Song Emperor Wu's enterprise beginning — reaching Qi's receiving mandate, seventy years.
translations.idiomatic: First year of Yixi, Song Emperor Wu's enterprise beginning — reaching Qi's receiving mandate, seventy years.

sentences.zh: 又讖曰：「蕭為二士天下樂。

translations.literal: Also prophecy says: "Xiao as two scholars — under Heaven joy.
translations.idiomatic: Also prophecy says, "Xiao as two scholars — under Heaven joy.

sentences.zh: 」案二士「主」字也。

translations.literal: " Case: two scholars is the character "master."
translations.idiomatic: " Case: two scholars is the character "master."

sentences.zh: 郭文舉金雄記曰：「當復有作，肅入草。

translations.literal: Guo Wenju Golden Hero Record says: "There will again be making — su enters grass.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Wenju Golden Hero Record says, "There will again be making — su enters grass.

sentences.zh: 」易曰：「聖人作，萬物睹。

translations.literal: " Changes says: "The sage makes — the myriad things behold.
translations.idiomatic: " Changes says, "The sage makes — the myriad things behold.

sentences.zh: 」「當復有作」，言聖人作也。

translations.literal: " "There will again be making" — speaks of the sage making.
translations.idiomatic: " "There will again be making" — speaks of the sage making.

sentences.zh: 王子年歌曰：「欲知其姓草肅 肅，穀中最細低頭熟，鱗身甲體永興福。

translations.literal: Prince Zinian's song says: "Want to know his surname grass su su, in the grain the finest low head ripe, scale body armor body forever flourishing blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zinian's song says, "Want to know his surname grass su su, in the grain the finest low head ripe, scale body armor body forever flourishing blessing.

sentences.zh: 」穀中精細者，稻也，即道也，熟猶成也。

translations.literal: " Finest in the grain is rice — that is dao; ripe is still cheng.
translations.idiomatic: " Finest in the grain is rice — that is dao; ripe is still cheng.

sentences.zh: 又歌曰：「金刀利刃齊刈之。

translations.literal: Also song says: "Golden knife sharp blade Qi mows.
translations.idiomatic: Also song says, "Golden knife sharp blade Qi mows.

sentences.zh: 」金刀「劉」字，刈猶翦也。

translations.literal: " Golden knife is the character "Liu"; mow is still cut.
translations.idiomatic: " Golden knife is the character "Liu"; mow is still cut.

sentences.zh: 孔子河洛讖曰：「堨河梁，塞龍泉，消除水災泄山川。

translations.literal: Confucius River-Luo prophecy says: "Dam river beam, block dragon spring, eliminate water calamity release mountains and streams.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius River-Luo prophecy says, "Dam river beam, block dragon spring, eliminate water calamity release mountains and streams.

sentences.zh: 」水即宋也，宋氏為災害，故曰水災。

translations.literal: " Water is Song; Song clan was calamity — therefore called water calamity.
translations.idiomatic: " Water is Song; Song clan was calamity — therefore called water calamity.

sentences.zh: 梁亦水也，堨河梁，則行路成矣。

translations.literal: Beam is also water; dam river beam — then the road becomes cheng.
translations.idiomatic: Beam is also water; dam river beam — then the road becomes cheng.

sentences.zh: 路，猶道也。

translations.literal: Road — still dao.
translations.idiomatic: Road — still dao.

sentences.zh: 消除水災，除宋水氏之災害也。

translations.literal: Eliminate water calamity — remove Song Water clan's calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Eliminate water calamity — remove Song Water clan's calamity.

sentences.zh: 河圖讖又曰：「上參南斗第一星，下立草屋為紫庭，神龍之岡梧桐生，鳳鳥戢翼朔旦鳴。

translations.literal: River Chart prophecy also says: "Above joins Southern Dipper first star, below establishes grass house as purple court, divine dragon's mound wutong grows, phoenix bird folds wings at dawn cries.
translations.idiomatic: River Chart prophecy also says, "Above joins Southern Dipper first star, below establishes grass house as purple court, divine dragon's mound wutong grows, phoenix bird folds wings at dawn cries.

sentences.zh: 」南斗，吳分野，草屋者居上，「蕭」字象也。

translations.literal: " Southern Dipper — Wu's field allotment; grass house is dwelling above — the character "Xiao" image.
translations.idiomatic: " Southern Dipper — Wu's field allotment; grass house is dwelling above — the character "Xiao" image.

sentences.zh: 先是，益州有山，古老相傳曰齊後山。

translations.literal: Before this, in Yi Province there was a mountain; the ancients mutually transmitted called Qi Rear Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, in Yi Province there was a mountain; the ancients mutually transmitted called Qi Rear Mountain.

sentences.zh: 升明三年四月二十三日，有沙門玄暢者，於此山立精舍，其日上登尊位。

translations.literal: On the twenty-third day of the fourth month of the third year of Shengming, there was the monk Xuan Chang who at this mountain established a monastery — that day he ascended the honored position.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-third day of the fourth month of the third year of Shengming, there was the monk Xuan Chang who at this mountain established a monastery — that day he ascended the honored position.

sentences.zh: 其月二十四日，滎陽郡人尹千，于嵩山東南隅見天雨石，墜地石開，有玉璽在其中。

translations.literal: That month on the twenty-fourth day, Yin Qian of Xingyang Commandery at Song Mountain's southeast corner saw Heaven rain stone; stone falling to earth opened — within was a jade seal.
translations.idiomatic: That month on the twenty-fourth day, Yin Qian of Xingyang Commandery at Song Mountain's southeast corner saw Heaven rain stone; stone falling to earth opened — within was a jade seal.

sentences.zh: 璽方三寸，文曰：「戊丁之人與道俱，肅然入草應天符，掃平河、洛清魏都。

translations.literal: The seal was three cun square; text said: "Man of wu-ding together with the Way, su-ran enters grass responding to Heaven's token, sweep flat He-Luo clear Wei capital.
translations.idiomatic: The seal was three cun square; text said, "Man of wu-ding together with the Way, su-ran enters grass responding to Heaven's token, sweep flat He-Luo clear Wei capital.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「皇帝運興。

translations.literal: " Also said: "Emperor's fortune rises.
translations.idiomatic: " Also said, "Emperor's fortune rises.

sentences.zh: 」千奉璽詣雍州刺史蕭赤斧，赤斧以獻。

translations.literal: " Qian presented the seal to Inspector of Yong Province Xiao Chifu; Chifu presented it.
translations.idiomatic: " Qian presented the seal to Xiao Chifu, Inspector of Yong Province; Chifu presented it.

sentences.zh: 案宋武帝于嵩高山得玉璧三十二枚，神人云：「此是宋卜世之數。

translations.literal: Case: Song Emperor Wu at Song High Mountain obtained thirty-two jade bi; the spirit man said: "These are Song's number of generations.
translations.idiomatic: Case: Song Emperor Wu at Song High Mountain obtained thirty-two jade bi; the spirit man said, "These are Song's number of generations.

sentences.zh: 」三十二者，二「三十」也，宋自受命至禪齊凡

translations.literal: " Thirty-two — two "thirty"; Song from receiving mandate to abdicating to Qi altogether
translations.idiomatic: " Thirty-two — two "thirty"; Song from receiving mandate to abdicating to Qi altogether

sentences.zh: 六十年。

translations.literal: sixty years.
translations.idiomatic: sixty years.

sentences.zh: 然則帝之符應也若是，今備之云。

translations.literal: Then the emperor's token and response was thus — now fully record it.
translations.idiomatic: Then the emperor's token and response was thus — now fully record it.

sentences.zh: 世祖武皇帝諱賾，字宣遠，高帝長子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of the Shizu line, taboo name Ze, style name Xuanyuan, was Emperor Gao's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of the Shizu line, whose taboo name was Ze, style name Xuanyuan, was Emperor Gao's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 以宋元嘉十七年六月己未生於建康縣之青溪宮。

translations.literal: He was born on the sixth month, day jiwei, seventeenth year of Yuanjia of Song, at Qingxi Palace in Jiankang County.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on jiwei in the sixth month of the seventeenth year of Yuanjia of Song, at Qingxi Palace in Jiankang County.

sentences.zh: 將產之夕，孝皇后、昭皇后並夢龍據屋，故小字上為龍兒。

translations.literal: On the eve of birth, Empress Xiao and Empress Zhao both dreamed dragons occupying the house — therefore his childhood name was Dragon Child above.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of birth, Empress Xiao and Empress Zhao both dreamed dragons occupying the house — therefore his childhood name was Dragon Child above.

sentences.zh: 年十三，夢人以筆劃身左右為兩翅，又著孔雀羽衣裳空中飛，舉體生毛，發長至足。

translations.literal: At age thirteen he dreamed a man with a brush drew on his body left and right as two wings; also wore peacock-feather garments flying in the air; his whole body grew hair, hair long to the feet.
translations.idiomatic: At age thirteen he dreamed a man with a brush drew on his body left and right as two wings; also wore peacock-feather garments flying in the air; his whole body grew hair, hair long to the feet.

sentences.zh: 有人指上所踐地曰：「周文王之田」。

translations.literal: Someone pointed at the ground the emperor trod and said: "King Wen of Zhou's field."
translations.idiomatic: Someone pointed at the ground the emperor trod and said, "King Wen of Zhou's field."

sentences.zh: 又於所住堂內得璽一枚，文曰：「皇帝行璽」。

translations.literal: Also in the hall where he dwelt he obtained a seal; text said: "Emperor's traveling seal."
translations.idiomatic: Also in the hall where he dwelt he obtained a seal; text said, "Emperor's traveling seal."

sentences.zh: 又得異錢，文為「北斗星」，雙刀、雙貝及有人形帶劍焉。

translations.literal: Also obtained strange coins; text was "Northern Dipper Star," double knife, double shell, and having human form bearing sword.
translations.idiomatic: Also obtained strange coins; text was "Northern Dipper Star," double knife, double shell, and having human form bearing sword.

sentences.zh: 仕宋為贛令。

translations.literal: He served Song as Magistrate of Gan.
translations.idiomatic: He served Song as Magistrate of Gan.

sentences.zh: 江州刺史晉安王子勳反，上不從命。

translations.literal: Governor of Jiang Province Prince of Jin'an Zi Xu rebelled; the emperor did not follow the command.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Jiang Province Prince of Jin'an Zi Xu rebelled; the emperor did not follow the command.

sentences.zh: 南康相沈肅之縶上郡獄，族人蕭欣祖、門客桓康等破郡迎出上，上遂率部曲百餘人起義。

translations.literal: Prime Minister of Nankang Shen Suzhi imprisoned the emperor in the commandery jail; clansman Xiao Xinnu, gate guest Huan Kang and others broke the commandery to welcome the emperor out; the emperor then led his personal troops, over one hundred men, to raise righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Prime Minister of Nankang Shen Suzhi imprisoned the emperor in the commandery jail; clansman Xiao Xinnu, gate guest Huan Kang and others broke the commandery to welcome the emperor out; the emperor then led his personal troops, over one hundred men, to raise righteousness.

sentences.zh: 避難揭陽山，有白雀來集，聞山中有清聲傳漏響。

translations.literal: Taking refuge at Mount Jieyang, a white sparrow came and gathered; heard within the mountain a clear sound transmitting the water-clock strike.
translations.idiomatic: Taking refuge at Mount Jieyang, a white sparrow came and gathered; heard within the mountain a clear sound transmitting the water-clock strike.

sentences.zh: 又于山累石為佛圖，其側忽生一樹，狀若華蓋，青翠扶疏，有殊群木。

translations.literal: Also at the mountain piled stones as a Buddha tower; beside it suddenly grew a tree shaped like a ceremonial canopy, green and luxuriant, different from the group of trees.
translations.idiomatic: Also at the mountain piled stones as a Buddha tower; beside it suddenly grew a tree shaped like a ceremonial canopy, green and luxuriant, different from the group of trees.

sentences.zh: 上將討戴凱之，大饗士卒。

translations.literal: The emperor was about to campaign against Dai Kaizhi; greatly feasted officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was about to campaign against Dai Kaizhi; greatly feasted officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 是日大熱，上各令折荊枝自蔽，言未終而有雲垂蔭，正當會所，會罷乃散。

translations.literal: That day was greatly hot; the emperor ordered each to break thorn branches to shade himself; words not yet ended and clouds hung shade — directly at the assembly place; when the assembly ended then dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: That day was greatly hot; the emperor ordered each to break thorn branches to shade himself; words not yet ended and clouds hung shade — directly at the assembly place; when the assembly ended then dispersed.

sentences.zh: 及為廣興相，嶺南積旱，連水阻涸，商旅不通。

translations.literal: When he was Prime Minister of Guangxing, south of the ranges drought accumulated; successive waters blocked and dried; merchants and travelers did not pass.
translations.idiomatic: When he was Prime Minister of Guangxing, south of the ranges drought accumulated; successive waters blocked and dried; merchants and travelers did not pass.

sentences.zh: 上部伍既至，無雨而川流暴起，遂得利涉。

translations.literal: When the emperor's boat arrived, without rain the river currents suddenly rose — then obtained profitable crossing.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor's boat arrived, without rain the river currents suddenly rose — then obtained profitable crossing.

sentences.zh: 元徽四年，累遷晉熙王鎮西長史、江夏內史，行郢州事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanhui he was repeatedly promoted to Western Campaigning Major of Prince of Jinxi, Interior Secretary of Jiangxia, acting for Ying Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuanhui he was repeatedly promoted to Western Campaigning Major of Prince of Jinxi, Interior Secretary of Jiangxia, acting for Ying Province.

sentences.zh: 順帝立，征晉熙王燮為撫軍、揚州刺史，以上為左衛將軍，輔燮俱下。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shun was established, Prince of Jinxi Xie was summoned as General Who Pacifies the Army, Governor of Yang Province; the emperor as General of the Left Guard assisted Xie together down.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shun was established, Prince of Jinxi Xie was summoned as General Who Pacifies the Army, Governor of Yang Province; the emperor as General of the Left Guard assisted Xie together down.

sentences.zh: 沈攸之事起，未得朝廷處分，上以中流可以待敵，即據盆口城為戰守備。

translations.literal: When Shen Youzhi's affair arose, not yet obtaining the court's disposition, the emperor because the middle stream could await the enemy — immediately held Pankou city as battle defense preparations.
translations.idiomatic: When Shen Youzhi's affair arose, not yet obtaining the court's disposition, the emperor because the middle stream could await the enemy — immediately held Pankou city as battle defense preparations.

sentences.zh: 高帝聞之曰：「此真我子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Gao hearing it said: "This is truly my son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gao hearing it said, "This is truly my son.

sentences.zh: 」於盆城掘塹，得一大錢，文曰：「太平百歲」。

translations.literal: " At Pankou city digging the moat, they obtained a great coin; text said: "Great peace one hundred years."
translations.idiomatic: " At Pankou city digging the moat, they obtained a great coin; text said, "Great peace one hundred years."

sentences.zh: 于時城內乏水，欲引水入城，始鑿城內，遇伏泉湧出，如此者九處，用之不竭。

translations.literal: At that time within the city water was lacking; wishing to lead water into the city, first digging within the city, encountered hidden springs surging out — thus nine places; using them inexhaustible.
translations.idiomatic: At that time within the city water was lacking; wishing to lead water into the city, first digging within the city, encountered hidden springs surging out — thus nine places; using them inexhaustible.

sentences.zh: 上表求西討，不許，乃遣偏軍援郢，平西將軍黃回等，皆受上節度。

translations.literal: The emperor submitted a memorial requesting western campaign; not permitted; then dispatched detached armies to aid Ying — General Who Pacifies the West Huang Hui and others — all received the emperor's command.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor submitted a memorial requesting western campaign; not permitted; then dispatched detached armies to aid Ying — Huang Hui, General Who Pacifies the West, and others — all received the emperor's command.

sentences.zh: 升明二年，事平，遷江州刺史，封聞喜縣侯。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shengming, when the affair was settled, he was transferred to Inspector of Jiang Province; enfeoffed as Marquis of Wenxi County.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shengming, when the affair was settled, he was transferred to Inspector of Jiang Province; enfeoffed as Marquis of Wenxi County.

sentences.zh: 其年，征侍中、領軍將軍。

translations.literal: That year he was summoned as Palace Attendant, Commander of the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was summoned as Palace Attendant, Commander of the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 尋加督京畿諸軍事。

translations.literal: Soon added command of Capital Region military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon added command of Capital Region military affairs.

sentences.zh: 三年，又加尚書僕射、中軍大將軍、開府儀同三司，進爵為公，給班劍二十人。

translations.literal: In the third year, again added Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand General of the Central Army, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon of the First Order; rank advanced to Duke; granted twenty swords of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, again added Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand General of the Central Army, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon of the First Order; rank advanced to Duke; granted twenty swords of office.

sentences.zh: 建元四年三月壬戌，高帝崩，是日，皇太子即皇帝位，大赦。

translations.literal: On the fourth month, third year of Jianyuan, on renxu Emperor Gao died; that day the crown prince ascended the imperial throne; great pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the fourth month of the third year of Jianyuan, Emperor Gao died; that day the crown prince ascended the imperial throne; great pardon.

sentences.zh: 征鎮州郡令長、軍屯營部，各行喪三日，不得擅離任。

translations.literal: He summoned magistrates of garrison provinces and commanderies, military garrison camps — each to observe mourning three days; must not leave post without authorization.
