translations.idiomatic: He summoned magistrates of garrison provinces and commanderies, military garrison camps — each to observe mourning three days; must not leave post without authorization.

sentences.zh: 都邑城守，防備幢隊，一不得還。

translations.literal: Capital city garrison defense, defense banner teams — none might return.
translations.idiomatic: Capital city garrison defense, defense banner teams — none might return.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，稱先帝遺詔，以司徒褚彥回錄尚書事，尚書左僕射王儉為尚書令，車騎將軍張敬兒開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On yichou he proclaimed the late emperor's final testament: Minister of Works Chu Yanhui as Recorder of the Department of State Affairs; Left Vice Director Wang Jian as Director; General of Chariots and Cavalry Zhang Jing'er Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon of the First Order.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he proclaimed the late emperor's final testament: Chu Yanhui as Minister of Works and Recorder of the Department of State Affairs; Wang Jian as Left Vice Director and Director of the Department of State Affairs; Zhang Jing'er, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon of the First Order.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「喪禮雖有定制，先旨每存簡約，內官可三日一還臨，外官間日一還臨，後有大喪皆如之。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Mourning rites though having fixed system, the prior intent always preserved simplicity; inner officials may return to mourn once every three days; outer officials once every other day — afterward for great mourning all like this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Mourning rites though having fixed system, the prior intent always preserved simplicity; inner officials may return to mourn once every three days; outer officials once every other day — afterward for great mourning all like this.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，以前將軍王奐為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: " On dingmao former General of the Front Wang Huan was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingmao Wang Huan, former General of the Front, was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以司空豫章王嶷為太尉。

translations.literal: On gengwu Minister of Works Prince of Yuzhang Yi was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Yi, Minister of Works and Prince of Yuzhang, was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔免逋城錢，自今以後，申明舊制。

translations.literal: On guiyou an edict remitted overdue wall-repair money; from now afterward declare the old system.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou an edict remitted overdue wall-repair money; from now afterward declare the old system.

sentences.zh: 初晉、宋舊制，受官二十日，輒送修城錢二千。

translations.literal: At first Jin and Song old system: receiving office twenty days, then send wall-repair money two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: At first Jin and Song old system: receiving office twenty days, then send wall-repair money two thousand.

sentences.zh: 宋泰始初，軍役大起，受官者萬計，兵戎機急，事有未遑，自是令僕以下，並不輸送。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taishi of Song, military service greatly arose; those receiving office numbered in the ten thousands; military affairs urgent — affairs had no leisure; from this the Director and below all did not submit payment.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taishi of Song, military service greatly arose; those receiving office numbered in the ten thousands; military affairs urgent — affairs had no leisure; from this the Director and below all did not submit payment.

sentences.zh: 二十年中，大限不可勝計，文符督切，擾亂在所，至是除蕩，百姓悅焉。

translations.literal: Within twenty years the great limit could not be counted; document tokens supervised and pressed — disturbance wherever located; reaching this it was eliminated and washed — the common people rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: Within twenty years the great limit could not be counted; document tokens supervised and pressed — disturbance wherever located; reaching this it was eliminated and washed — the common people rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，追尊穆妃為皇后。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on xinmao, posthumously honored Consort Mu as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on xinmao, posthumously honored Consort Mu as Empress.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，以高皇帝配南郊，高昭皇后配北郊。

translations.literal: On the fifth month, on gengshen, Emperor Gao was paired at the southern suburb; Empress Gao-Zhao paired at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the fifth month, Emperor Gao was paired at the southern suburb; Empress Gao-Zhao paired at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申朔，立南郡王長懋為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the sixth month, on jiashen new year's day, Prince of Nan Commandery Changmao was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen new year's day in the sixth month, Prince of Nan Commandery Changmao was established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 詔申壬戌赦恩百日。

translations.literal: An edict extended the renxu pardon grace one hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: An edict extended the renxu pardon grace one hundred days.

sentences.zh: 丙申，立皇太子妃王氏。

translations.literal: On bingshen the crown prince's consort Lady Wang was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the crown prince's consort Lady Wang was established.

sentences.zh: 進封聞喜公子良為竟陵王，臨汝公子卿為廬陵王，應城公子敬為安陸王，江陵公子懋為晉安王，枝江公子隆為隨王，皇子子真為建安王，皇孫昭業為南郡王。

translations.literal: Advanced Wenxi Duke Ziliang to Prince of Jingling, Linru Duke Ziqing to Prince of Luling, Yingcheng Duke Zijing to Prince of Anlu, Jiangling Duke Zimao to Prince of Jin'an, Zhijiang Duke Zilong to Prince of Sui, Prince Zizhen as Prince of Jian'an; imperial grandson Zhaoye as Prince of Nan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Advanced Wenxi Duke Ziliang to Prince of Jingling, Linru Duke Ziqing to Prince of Luling, Yingcheng Duke Zijing to Prince of Anlu, Jiangling Duke Zimao to Prince of Jin'an, Zhijiang Duke Zilong to Prince of Sui, Prince Zizhen as Prince of Jian'an; imperial grandson Zhaoye as Prince of Nan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以水潦為患，星緯乖序，克日訊都下囚，諸遠獄委刺史以時察判。

translations.literal: On wuxu because flood was calamity, constellations and weft out of order — on appointed day interrogated capital prisoners; various distant prisons entrusted to inspectors for timely judgment.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu because flood was calamity, constellations and weft out of order — on appointed day interrogated capital prisoners; various distant prisons entrusted to inspectors for timely judgment.

sentences.zh: 建康、秣陵二縣貧人加振賜，必令周悉。

translations.literal: Jiankang and Molin two counties' poor people added relief grants — must make thorough.
translations.idiomatic: Jiankang and Molin two counties' poor people added relief grants — must make thorough.

sentences.zh: 吳興、義興遭水縣，蠲除租調。

translations.literal: Wuxing and Yixing flood counties — remitted rent and tax.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxing and Yixing flood counties — remitted rent and tax.

sentences.zh: 以司徒褚彥回為司空。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Chu Yanhui was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Chu Yanhui was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸卯，司空褚彥回薨。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on guimao, Minister of Works Chu Yanhui died.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the eighth month, on guimao, Chu Yanhui, Minister of Works, died.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，以國哀故，罷國子學。

translations.literal: On the ninth month, on dingsi, because of national mourning, the Imperial Academy was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the ninth month, because of national mourning, the Imperial Academy was stopped.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以征南將軍王僧虔為左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On xinwei General Who Campaigns South Wang Sengqian was made Left Grand Master of the Bright Hall, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon of the First Order.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Wang Sengqian, General Who Campaigns South, was made Left Grand Master of the Bright Hall, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon of the First Order.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，以中書令王延之為尚書左僕射。

translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the sixth month, Wei men came on a friendly visit.

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Prince of Changsha Huang died.

translations.literal: On bingshen great thunder and rain; there was yellow light filling Heaven — illuminating the earth like gold.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen great thunder and rain; there was yellow light filling Heaven — illuminating the earth like gold.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，都下大風髮屋。

translations.literal: On yiyou great wind in the capital lifted roofs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou great wind in the capital lifted roofs.

translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on guimao, an edict: because yin and yang were not in harmony, constellations and weft out of measure, the heir apparent suffered illness — delayed the calendar

sentences.zh: 旬晷，可大赦。

translations.literal: ten days and moments — may great pardon.
translations.idiomatic: ten days and moments — may great pardon.

translations.idiomatic: On renchen Zixiang, Inspector of Jing Province and Prince of Badong, rebelled; he dispatched Xiao Shunzhi, Governor of Danyang, to suppress him; Zixiang was executed.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月戊寅，詔量增尚書丞郎賜祿。

translations.idiomatic: In winter, the twelfth month, on wuyin, an edict measured increase of Director and Gentleman of the Department of State Affairs' granted salary.

translations.idiomatic: On jimao changed enfeoffment Zilin, Prince of Xuancheng, to Prince of Nankang; established Prince Zijian as Prince of Xiangdong.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月甲午，省平蠻府。

translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month of the ninth year, on jiawu, the Pacifying Barbarians office was abolished.

translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he sacrificed at the southern suburb; reduced capital visible prisoners.

translations.idiomatic: On wuwu an edict: Pei Zhaoming, Director of the Archers' Guard, on a friendly visit to Wei.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，明堂災。

translations.literal: On the third month, on guisi, the Bright Hall suffered fire.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the third month, the Bright Hall suffered fire.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙申，林邑國獻金簟。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on bingshen, the Kingdom of Linyi presented a golden mat.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fifth month, on bingshen, the Kingdom of Linyi presented a golden mat.

translations.literal: On dingwei Wei men came on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Wei men came on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 安成王暠薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Ancheng Gao died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Ancheng Gao died.

translations.literal: On jiwei the Zhengyang Hall of Leyou suffered fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the Zhengyang Hall of Leyou suffered fire.

translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the eighth month, on jihai, he sent Xiao Chen, Minister of Works Aide, on a friendly visit to Wei.

sentences.zh: 吳興、義興大水。

translations.literal: Wuxing and Yixing great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxing and Yixing suffered great flood.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，蠲二郡租。

translations.literal: On yimao remitted the two commanderies' rent.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao remitted the two commanderies' rent.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，幸琅邪城講武，觀者傾都，普頒酒肉。

translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the ninth month, he visited Langye city to lecture on military affairs; spectators filled the capital; broadly distributed wine and meat.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，魏人來聘。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiayin, Wei men came on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jiayin, Wei men came on a friendly visit.

translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month of the tenth year, on wuwu, Ziliang, Minister of Works and Prince of Jingling, held Director of the Department of State Affairs; Luan, Right Vice Director and Marquis of Xichang, was made Left Vice Director.

translations.idiomatic: An edict increased inner and outer busy officials' salary and stipend.

translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the twelfth month, he sent Xiao Chen, Minister of Works Aide, on a friendly visit to Wei.

translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month of the eleventh year, on wuwu, Wang Jingze, Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Yu Province, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，皇太子長懋薨。

translations.literal: On yihai the crown prince Changmao died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the crown prince Changmao died.

translations.literal: In the second month, Inspector of Yong Province Wang Huan had crime and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Wang Huan, Inspector of Yong Province, had crime and was executed.

translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the third month, Wang Yan, Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on guiwei, Wei men came on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on guiwei, Wei men came on a friendly visit.

translations.idiomatic: On jiawu imperial grandson Zhaoye was established as imperial great-grandson; granted under Heaven those who were fathers' heirs one rank of nobility.

translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the fifth month, because of drought, the capital's two counties, Zhufang and Gudou temporarily cut off wine.

translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingsi, partial pardon of South Yan, Yan, Yu, Si, and Xu five provinces; South Yu Province's Liyang, Qiao, Linjiang, Lujiang four commanderies' three taxes — mass overdue old debts — all likewise originally remitted.

translations.idiomatic: Those along the Huai and newly attached émigrés of Qing and Ji — exemption already finished — again extended five years.

translations.literal: Before this in Wei territory a song said: "Red fire flows south — loses southern state."
translations.idiomatic: Before this in Wei territory a song said, "Red fire flows south — loses southern state."

translations.literal: This year a monk from the north carried this fire and arrived — color redder than ordinary fire yet faint; claiming to treat illness.
translations.idiomatic: This year a monk from the north carried this fire and arrived — color redder than ordinary fire yet faint; claiming to treat illness.

sentences.zh: 貴賤爭取之，多得其驗。

translations.literal: Noble and base competed to take it — many obtained verification.
translations.idiomatic: Noble and base competed to take it — many obtained verification.

translations.literal: Twenty-odd days — in the capital greatly flourishing; all said: "Sacred fire."
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-odd days — in the capital greatly flourishing; all said, "Sacred fire."

sentences.zh: 詔禁之不止。

translations.literal: An edict forbade it — did not stop.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade it — did not stop.

sentences.zh: 火灸至七炷而疾愈。

translations.literal: Fire moxibustion to seven applications and illness cured.
translations.idiomatic: Fire moxibustion to seven applications and illness cured.

translations.idiomatic: Qiu Guobin of Wu Xing secretly returned to his village; village man Yang Daoqing feigned illness twenty years — according to the method moxibustioned and immediately recovered.

translations.literal: This month the emperor was unwell; moved to reside at Yanchang Hall; first ascending the steps and the hall roof cried out — the emperor hated it.
translations.idiomatic: This month the emperor was unwell; moved to reside at Yanchang Hall; first ascending the steps and the hall roof cried out — the emperor hated it.

translations.literal: Wei armies were about to arrive; the emperor feared court and field worry and panic; forced by illness summoned the Music Office to play orthodox music and performers.
translations.idiomatic: Wei armies were about to arrive; the emperor feared court and field worry and panic; forced by illness summoned the Music Office to play orthodox music and performers.

translations.literal: On wuyin greatly failing, an edict said: "Beginning and end great term — sages and worthies cannot avoid; my years reach sixty — again what regret.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin greatly failing, an edict said, "Beginning and end great term — sages and worthies cannot avoid; my years reach sixty — again what regret.

sentences.zh: 但皇業艱難，萬機自重，不能無遺慮耳。

translations.literal: But the imperial enterprise is difficult; myriad affairs are again weighty — cannot be without remaining concern.
translations.idiomatic: But the imperial enterprise is difficult; myriad affairs are again weighty — cannot be without remaining concern.

sentences.zh: 太孫進德日茂，社稷有寄，子良善相毗輔，思弘正道。

translations.literal: The great-grandson advances in virtue day by day flourishing — the ancestral altar has reliance; Ziliang skillfully assists and supports — think to spread the correct Way.
translations.idiomatic: The great-grandson advances in virtue day by day flourishing — the ancestral altar has reliance; Ziliang skillfully assists and supports — think to spread the correct Way.

sentences.zh: 內外眾事無大小，悉與鸞參懷。

translations.literal: Inner and outer multitude of affairs without large or small — all consult with Luan.
translations.idiomatic: Inner and outer multitude of affairs without large or small — all consult with Luan.

sentences.zh: 尚書是職務根本，悉委王晏、徐孝嗣。

translations.literal: Director of the Department of State Affairs is the root of duties — all entrust to Wang Yan and Xu Xiaosi.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Department of State Affairs is the root of duties — all entrust to Wang Yan and Xu Xiaosi.

sentences.zh: 軍旅捍邊之略，委王敬則、陳顯達、王廣之、王玄邈、沈文季、張瑰、薛深等。

translations.literal: Army travel and border defense strategy — entrust to Wang Jingze, Chen Xianda, Wang Guangzhi, Wang Xuanmiao, Shen Wenji, Zhang Gui, Xue Shen and others.
translations.idiomatic: Army travel and border defense strategy — entrust to Wang Jingze, Chen Xianda, Wang Guangzhi, Wang Xuanmiao, Shen Wenji, Zhang Gui, Xue Shen and others.

sentences.zh: 百辟庶僚，各奉爾職，謹事太孫，勿有懈怠。

translations.literal: Hundred ministers and myriad officials — each keep your office; reverently serve the great-grandson; do not have slackness.
translations.idiomatic: Hundred ministers and myriad officials — each keep your office; reverently serve the great-grandson; do not have slackness.

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「我識滅後，身上著夏衣畫天衣，純烏犀導，絓諸器服，悉不得用寶物及織成等，唯裝復夾衣各一通。

translations.literal: Ordinarily worn knives long and short two — iron ring ones — along enter the inner coffin.
translations.idiomatic: Ordinarily worn knives long and short two — iron ring ones — along enter the inner coffin.

sentences.zh: 祭敬之典，本在因心，靈上慎勿以牲為祭。

translations.literal: Sacrifice and reverence rites — origin is in the heart; numinous above carefully do not take livestock as sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice and reverence rites — origin is in the heart; numinous above carefully do not take livestock as sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 祭惟設餅、茶飲、乾飯、酒脯而已。

translations.literal: Sacrifice only set cakes, tea drink, dried rice, wine and dried meat — that is all.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice only set cakes, tea drink, dried rice, wine and dried meat — that is all.

sentences.zh: 天下貴賤，咸同此制。

translations.literal: Under Heaven noble and base — all same this system.
translations.idiomatic: Under Heaven noble and base — all same this system.

sentences.zh: 未山陵前，朔望設菜食。

translations.literal: Before the mountain tomb, on new and full moon set vegetable food.
translations.idiomatic: Before the mountain tomb, on new and full moon set vegetable food.

sentences.zh: 陵墓萬世所宅，意常恨休安陵未稱，今可用東三處地最東邊以葬我，名為景安陵。

translations.literal: The tomb mound is the eternal dwelling — mind constantly regretted Xiuan Tomb not called fitting — now may use the eastern three places of land most east to bury me; name it Jing'an Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The tomb mound is the eternal dwelling — mind constantly regretted Xiuan Tomb not called fitting — now may use the eastern three places of land most east to bury me; name it Jing'an Tomb.

sentences.zh: 喪禮每存省約，不須煩人，百官停六時入臨，朔望祖日可依舊。

translations.literal: Mourning rites always preserve reduction and simplicity — need not trouble people; hundred officials stop six times entering mourning; new and full moon and ancestral days may follow the old.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning rites always preserve reduction and simplicity — need not trouble people; hundred officials stop six times entering mourning; new and full moon and ancestral days may follow the old.

sentences.zh: 諸主六宮，並不須從山陵。

translations.literal: Various princesses six palaces — all need not follow the mountain tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Various princesses six palaces — all need not follow the mountain tomb.

sentences.zh: 內殿鳳華、壽昌、曜靈三處，是吾所改制。

translations.literal: Inner hall Fenghua, Shouchang, Yaoling three places — are what I reformed.
translations.idiomatic: Inner hall Fenghua, Shouchang, Yaoling three places — are what I reformed.

sentences.zh: 夫貴有天下，富兼四海，宴處寢息，不容乃陋，謂此為奢儉之中，慎勿壞去。

translations.literal: Husband honored with all under Heaven, rich combining the four seas — resting place and sleep cannot tolerate being crude — call this middle of extravagance and thrift — carefully do not destroy.
translations.idiomatic: Husband honored with all under Heaven, rich combining the four seas — resting place and sleep cannot tolerate being crude — call this middle of extravagance and thrift — carefully do not destroy.

sentences.zh: 顯陽殿玉像諸佛及供養，具如別牒，可盡心禮拜供養之。

translations.literal: Xianyang Hall jade images various Buddhas and offerings — all as separate document — may exhaust heart bow and worship and offer.
translations.idiomatic: Xianyang Hall jade images various Buddhas and offerings — all as separate document — may exhaust heart bow and worship and offer.

sentences.zh: 應有功德事，可專在中。

translations.literal: Merit affairs that should be — may specially be at Central.
translations.idiomatic: Merit affairs that should be — may specially be at Central.

sentences.zh: 自今公私皆不得出家為道，及起立塔寺，以宅為精舍，並嚴斷之。

translations.literal: From now public and private all must not leave home to become dao; and establish and raise pagodas and temples; take residence as monastery — all strictly cut off.
translations.idiomatic: From now public and private all must not leave home to become dao; and establish and raise pagodas and temples; take residence as monastery — all strictly cut off.

sentences.zh: 惟年六十，必有道心，聽朝賢選序，已有別詔。

translations.literal: Only age sixty — must have the mind of the Way; hear court worthies select and order — already have separate edict.
translations.idiomatic: Only age sixty — must have the mind of the Way; hear court worthies select and order — already have separate edict.

sentences.zh: 諸小小賜乞，及合內處分，亦有別牒。

translations.literal: Various small grants and petitions and inner palace disposition — also have separate document.
translations.idiomatic: Various small grants and petitions and inner palace disposition — also have separate document.

sentences.zh: 內外禁衛勞舊主帥左右，悉令蕭諶優量驅使之。

translations.literal: Inner and outer forbidden guard labor old commanders left and right — all order Xiao Chen favorably measure and drive and use.
translations.idiomatic: Inner and outer forbidden guard labor old commanders left and right — all order Xiao Chen favorably measure and drive and use.

sentences.zh: 」是日上崩於延昌殿，年五十四。

translations.literal: " That day the emperor died at Yanchang Hall, age fifty-four.
translations.idiomatic: " That day the emperor died at Yanchang Hall, age fifty-four.

sentences.zh: 群臣上諡曰武皇帝，廟號世祖。

translations.literal: The ministers submitted posthumous title Emperor Wu; temple name Shizu.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers submitted posthumous title Emperor Wu; temple name Shizu.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，葬景安陵。

translations.literal: On the ninth month, on bingyin, buried at Jing'an Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the ninth month, buried at Jing'an Tomb.

sentences.zh: 上剛毅有斷，政總大體，以富國為先。

translations.literal: The emperor was firm and resolute with decision; government grasped the great pattern; making the state rich came first.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was firm and resolute with decision; government grasped the great pattern; making the state rich came first.

sentences.zh: 頗喜遊宴、雕綺之事，言常恨之，未能頓遣。

translations.literal: He quite liked wandering feasts and carved silk affairs; he often regretted this — could not suddenly dismiss.
translations.idiomatic: He quite liked wandering feasts and carved silk affairs; he often regretted this — could not suddenly dismiss.

sentences.zh: 臨崩，又詔：「凡諸游費，宜從休息。

translations.literal: Facing death, again an edict: "All various wandering expenses — ought from rest.
translations.idiomatic: Facing death, again an edict: "All various wandering expenses — ought from rest.

sentences.zh: 自今遠近薦獻，務存節儉，不得出界營求，相高奢麗。

translations.literal: From now near and far tribute presentation — must preserve thrift — must not go beyond borders seeking — mutually competing in high luxury.
translations.idiomatic: From now near and far tribute presentation — must preserve thrift — must not go beyond borders seeking — mutually competing in high luxury.

sentences.zh: 金粟繒纊，敝人已甚，珠玉玩好，傷俗尤重，嚴加禁絕。」

translations.literal: Gold grain silk floss — the people are already very worn; pearl jade playthings — harming custom especially heavy — strictly add prohibition."
translations.idiomatic: Gold grain silk floss — the people are already very worn; pearl jade playthings — harming custom especially heavy — strictly add prohibition."

sentences.zh: 論曰：齊高帝基命之初，武功潛用，泰始開運，大拯時艱。

translations.literal: Discussion says: Qi Emperor Gao at the foundation of mandate's beginning — military achievement secretly used; Taishi opened fortune — greatly saved the time's hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Discussion says: Qi Emperor Gao at the foundation of mandate's beginning — military achievement secretly used; Taishi opened fortune — greatly saved the time's hardship.

sentences.zh: 及蒼梧暴虐，釁結朝野，而百姓懍懍，命縣朝夕。

translations.literal: When Cangwu acted with violent cruelty — trouble knotted court and field — yet the common people were fearful — life hung morning and evening.
translations.idiomatic: When Cangwu acted with violent cruelty — trouble knotted court and field — yet the common people were fearful — life hung morning and evening.

sentences.zh: 權道既行，兼濟天下。

translations.literal: Expedient Way already walked — together crossed the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Expedient Way already walked — together crossed the realm.

sentences.zh: 元功振主，利器難以假人，群方戮力，實懷尺寸之望，豈惟天厭水行，固已人希木德，歸功與能，事極乎此。

translations.literal: Primary merit shook the ruler — sharp vessel hard to lend to others — the various directions together strove — truly harbored inch and foot hope — how only Heaven tired of the Water line — surely already men desired Wood virtue — returning merit to the able — affairs reached this.
translations.idiomatic: Primary merit shook the ruler — sharp vessel hard to lend to others — the various directions together strove — truly harbored inch and foot hope — not only did Heaven tire of the Water line — men already desired Wood virtue — returning merit to the able — affairs reached this.

sentences.zh: 武帝雲雷伊始，功參佐命，雖為繼體，事實艱難。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu at cloud and thunder's first beginning — achievement participated in assisting mandate — though as succeeding body — affairs truly difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu at cloud and thunder's first beginning — achievement participated in assisting mandate — though as succeeding body — affairs truly difficult.

sentences.zh: 禦袞垂旒，深存政典，文武授任，不革舊章，明罰厚恩，皆由己出。

translations.literal: Facing the imperial robe and hanging tassels — deeply preserved government canon; civil and military entrusted appointment — not changing old chapters; clear punishment and thick grace — all from himself issued.
translations.idiomatic: Facing the imperial robe and hanging tassels — deeply preserved government canon; civil and military entrusted appointment — not changing old chapters; clear punishment and thick grace — all from himself issued.

sentences.zh: 外表無塵，內朝多豫，機事平理，職貢有恆，府藏內充，人鮮勞役。

translations.literal: Outside appearance without dust — inner court much leisure; machine affairs peacefully ordered — tribute and duties had constant; treasury inner full — men rarely labor service.
translations.idiomatic: Outside appearance without dust — inner court much leisure; machine affairs peacefully ordered — tribute and duties had constant; treasury inner full — men rarely labor service.

sentences.zh: 宮室苑圃，未足以傷財，安樂延年，眾庶所同幸，亦有齊之良主也。

translations.literal: Palaces and parks — not enough to harm wealth; peace and joy extending years — the multitude's shared fortune — also had Qi's good lord.
translations.idiomatic: Palaces and parks — not enough to harm wealth; peace and joy extending years — the multitude's shared fortune — also had Qi's good lord.

sentences.zh: 據齊、梁紀錄，並雲出自蕭何，又編御史大夫望之以為先祖之次。

translations.literal: According to Qi and Liang records — all say coming out from Xiao He; also compiled Grand Censor Wang Zhi as ancestor's order.
translations.idiomatic: According to Qi and Liang records — all say coming out from Xiao He; also compiled Grand Censor Wang Zhi as ancestor's order.

sentences.zh: 案何及望之於漢俱為勳德，而望之本傳不有此陳，齊典所書，便乖實錄。

translations.literal: Case: He and Zhi in Han both were merit and virtue — yet Zhi's original biography does not have this statement; Qi canon what it writes — then departs from true record.
translations.idiomatic: Case: He and Zhi in Han both were merit and virtue — yet Zhi's original biography does not have this statement; Qi canon what it writes — then departs from true record.

sentences.zh: 近秘書監顏師古博考經籍，注解漢書，已正其非，今隨而改削云。

translations.literal: Recently Palace Library Director Yan Shigu broadly examined classics and records, annotated the Book of Han — already corrected its error; now follow and revise and cut thus.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Yan Shigu, Palace Library Director, broadly examined classics and records, annotated the Book of Han — already corrected its error; now follow and revise and cut thus.
